Hanya beberapa menit dari Savaya Beach Club dan Pantai Melasti, Villa Imala menawarkan privasi absolut, prestise tanpa tanding, dan pengalaman liburan yang akan dikenang selamanya.

descriptionSections.body:
Welcome to Villa Imala, your private slice of paradise in Uluwatu. This 6-bedroom retreat blends modern design, calming hillside views, and the soft ocean breeze to create a relaxing atmosphere.

You’ll love the expansive 80m² pool wrapped in natural wood decking, the tranquil spa room, the gym, and the inviting outdoor areas crafted for long, easy days under the Bali sun.

Villa Imala offers a phenomenal escape that feels welcoming and effortlessly relaxing from the moment you arrive.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
VILLA IMALA — ULTRA-LUXURY 6BR OCEAN VIEW VILLA WITH SPA & GYM IN ULUWATU

Welcome to Villa Imala, a spectacular 6-bedroom luxury private villa in Uluwatu, offering ocean views, expansive living spaces, and exclusive wellness facilities, just minutes from Savaya, Melasti Beach, and Uluwatu’s most iconic coastline.

Perfect for families, groups of friends, and retreats, Villa Imala combines modern tropical design, total privacy, and five-star services to deliver a true resort-style experience in your own private villa.


SPACIOUS OPEN-PLAN LIVING DESIGNED FOR GROUP COMFORT

From the moment you enter, the villa welcomes you with wide open spaces, high ceilings, and seamless indoor-outdoor flow. The bright living area connects naturally to the pool deck and outdoor lounges, creating an ideal setting for social moments, long meals, and sunset drinks.

You will enjoy:
• Elegant open living room with designer seating
• Fully equipped modern kitchen
• Large indoor dining area
• Outdoor dining and lounge spaces overlooking the pool and hills

Everything is designed for easy, luxurious group living.


FIVE PRIVATE SUITES — COMFORT & PRIVACY FOR ALL GUESTS

Villa Imala features five beautifully appointed bedrooms, each with private en-suite bathrooms for maximum comfort and privacy.

Configuration includes:
• Four spacious king-size suites with premium bedding
• One comfortable twin bedroom, ideal for children or friends
• Smart TVs and generous wardrobe space in all rooms
• One king suite with a bathtub for added relaxation

Every room is designed as a calm private retreat after a day at the beach or exploring Uluwatu.


80M² PRIVATE POOL & ROOFTOP WITH OCEAN VIEWS

At the heart of the villa lies your 80m² private swimming pool, surrounded by sun loungers and relaxed outdoor seating, perfect for enjoying Bali’s tropical climate all day long.

For elevated moments, head up to the rooftop terrace, where oversized daybeds and open views create the perfect setting for sunset drinks, morning yoga, or quiet evenings overlooking the ocean and hills of Uluwatu.


PRIVATE SPA & PANORAMIC GYM — WELLNESS INSIDE YOUR VILLA

Villa Imala stands out with dedicated wellness facilities rarely found in private villas.

Enjoy:
• A private spa room for massages and relaxation treatments
• A glass-wall gym with panoramic views, ideal for workouts with natural light and ocean breeze

Whether you want to stay active or fully unwind, wellness is built directly into your stay.


PRIME ULUWATU LOCATION — CLOSE TO BEACHES & BEACH CLUBS

Villa Imala is ideally located:
• 5 minutes to Savaya Beach Club
• 10 minutes to Melasti Beach
• Close to Uluwatu surf spots, cliff viewpoints, cafés, and restaurants

You stay close to all attractions while enjoying total peace and privacy once back at the villa.


FIVE-STAR SERVICES & DEDICATED VILLA MANAGER

Your stay at Villa Imala is supported by our professional on-site team and a dedicated Villa Manager, available to ensure everything runs smoothly throughout your stay.

Services include:
• Personalized check-in
• Daily housekeeping
• Dedicated guest support
• Concierge services for transport, private chef, spa treatments, tours, and activities

Our goal is to provide hotel-level service with the privacy of a luxury villa.


IDEAL FOR

• Families traveling together
• Groups of friends
• Wellness retreats
• Long luxury stays in Bali
• Guests seeking space, privacy, and premium facilities


THE VILLA IMALA EXPERIENCE

Villa Imala is more than a place to stay. It is a private luxury retreat combining ocean views, generous space, wellness facilities, and five-star service in one of Bali’s most sought-after destinations.

A perfect base to relax, reconnect, and experience the very best of Uluwatu in complete comfort.

descriptionSections.title: Guest access
descriptionSections.body:
Guests will enjoy exclusive and private access to the entire villa, including all indoor and outdoor areas. During your stay, the property is reserved only for your group, ensuring full privacy and a peaceful atmosphere throughout the villa.

You will have full access to all amenities, including the private swimming pool, rooftop terrace with ocean views, spa room, gym, living and dining areas, fully equipped kitchen, and all bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms.

There are no shared spaces with other guests. Only authorized staff may enter the property when necessary for housekeeping, maintenance, or requested services, and always with respect for your privacy.

Villa Imala is ideal for guests looking for a fully private luxury villa experience in Uluwatu, with spacious indoor and outdoor areas designed for families, groups, and longer stays

descriptionSections.title: Other things to note
descriptionSections.body:
Please note that Bali will observe Nyepi (Silent Day) on 19 March 2026. This important Balinese Hindu day of silence starts at 6:00 AM and ends at 6:00 AM the following day. During this period, the entire island comes to a complete stop: no outdoor activities, no traffic, no flights, and no check-ins or check-outs are permitted.

To ensure a smooth stay, our Villa Manager will coordinate your arrival and departure times in advance if your booking is close to Nyepi.

Upon arrival, you will receive a full introduction to Villa Imala, its facilities, and the surrounding Uluwatu area, including recommendations for beaches, restaurants, beach clubs, and wellness experiences.

Guests will also receive keys and access to our digital guest guide (via QR code) with curated local recommendations and practical information for your stay.

Tropical Environment Notice

Villa Imala is located in a natural tropical environment typical of Uluwatu, offering ocean views, open spaces, and lush surroundings. As in all tropical areas of Bali, occasional insects or small wildlife may be present. Our team performs regular deep cleaning and preventive treatments to maintain comfort and cleanliness throughout your stay.

Nearby Construction Notice

Please be aware that there is construction work near the villa, which may occasionally cause some noise during daytime hours. While we do our best to minimize any inconvenience, this is outside of our control and may vary depending on the construction schedule.

If you have any questions about Nyepi, the surrounding area, or need help planning your stay, our team will be happy to assist before your arrival. We look forward to welcoming you and providing a relaxing and memorable stay at Villa Imala.

descriptionSections.title: The space

VILLA MAHINA – LUXURY 3BR VILLA WALKING DISTANCE TO BERAWA BEACH

Villa Mahina is a contemporary luxury 3-bedroom villa ideally located in the heart of Berawa, Canggu’s most sought-after neighborhood. Just 400 meters from Berawa Beach and moments away from Bali’s most vibrant lifestyle destinations, the villa offers the perfect balance between privacy, comfort, and immediate access to the island’s best beach clubs, restaurants, cafés, and nightlife.

Nestled within a private residence and set back from the main road, Villa Mahina provides a peaceful sanctuary while remaining at the center of everything that makes Canggu one of Bali’s most desirable destinations.

THREE PRIVATE BEDROOM SUITES

Designed with comfort and simplicity in mind, each bedroom features:

• Premium king-size bedding
• Private en-suite bathroom
• Elegant contemporary design
• Air conditioning
• Ample storage space

Bright and comfortable, the bedrooms offer a relaxing retreat after a day exploring Bali.

PRIVATE POOL & TROPICAL OUTDOOR LIVING

At the heart of the villa lies a private swimming pool surrounded by tropical greenery and sun loungers.

Whether enjoying a morning coffee by the pool, an afternoon swim, or a sunset cocktail before heading to Berawa Beach, the outdoor space has been designed to embrace Bali’s tropical lifestyle.

SPACIOUS OPEN LIVING AREA

The villa’s generous living and dining area is enhanced by high ceilings that create an exceptional sense of space and natural light.

The open-plan design includes:

• Large lounge area
• Fully equipped modern kitchen
• Spacious dining area
• Seamless indoor-outdoor living

The result is a bright, airy, and welcoming atmosphere ideal for families, friends, and long stays.

PRIME BERAWA LOCATION

One of Villa Mahina’s greatest assets is its unbeatable location.

Within walking distance you will find:

• Berawa Beach (400m)
• Finns Beach Club
• Atlas Beach Club
• Mesa Restaurant
• Jedd
• Volt
• Trendy cafés, boutiques, gyms, and wellness centers

Enjoy Bali’s most spectacular sunsets, morning beach walks, world-class dining, and vibrant nightlife, all just minutes from your doorstep.

FIVE-STAR SERVICES

Our team is dedicated to ensuring a seamless and memorable stay with:

• Personalized check-in
• Daily housekeeping
• Concierge assistance
• Airport transfers
• Private chef services
• Spa and wellness experiences
• Tour and activity arrangements

IDEAL FOR

• Families
• Groups of friends
• Digital nomads
• Long stays
• Beach lovers
• Guests seeking both privacy and prime location

THE VILLA MAHINA EXPERIENCE

Villa Mahina combines contemporary design, spacious living, and one of the best locations in Bali. A private tropical retreat where you can enjoy the energy of Berawa and Canggu while returning home to complete peace, comfort, and privacy.

descriptionSections.title: Guest access
descriptionSections.body:
You will enjoy exclusive access to the entire Villa Mahina, ensuring complete privacy, comfort, and tranquility throughout your stay. Located within a private residence in the heart of Berawa, the villa offers a peaceful retreat just 400 meters from Berawa Beach and minutes from Canggu’s most iconic lifestyle destinations.

Relax by your private swimming pool surrounded by tropical greenery, unwind on the sun loungers, or enjoy the spacious outdoor deck designed for Bali’s indoor-outdoor lifestyle. The villa also features a fully equipped modern kitchen, a generous dining area, and a bright open-plan living space with high ceilings that create an exceptional sense of space and natural light.

The villa features two full bathrooms: one private en-suite bathroom connected to the master bedroom, and one shared bathroom for the other two bedrooms. An additional guest toilet is conveniently located on the ground floor. Double-glazed windows help ensure a calm and restful atmosphere while being just moments away from the vibrant energy of Berawa.

Whether you are spending your days enjoying sunset walks on the beach, exploring Bali’s best restaurants and cafés, or simply relaxing by the pool, Villa Mahina has been designed to provide a seamless blend of luxury, privacy, and convenience in one of Bali’s most desirable locations.

The villa has a beautiful design and looks exactly like the photos. However, the overall construction quality could be improved, as the property requires quite a bit of maintenance.
The main entrance door is difficult to close, and the door leading to the living area is also not well maintained. The bedroom and bathroom door handles also seem to need some repairs.
The pantry was missing some basic amenities such as tea and sugar, and there was no microwave, which would have been a nice addition. It would also be thoughtful to provide basic toiletries such as toothpaste and toothbrushes for guests.
On the positive side, the bed was very comfortable, and the location is excellent. It is very convenient, close to many attractions, and easy to find.
Overall, the villa has great potential because of its beautiful design and excellent location. With better maintenance and a few additional amenities, it would provide an even better experience for guests.

Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback.
We're delighted to hear that you enjoyed the villa's beautiful design, comfortable bed, and excellent location. We truly appreciate your positive comments and your recognition of the property's potential.
Regarding the amenities, we would like to kindly clarify that the information about the provided facilities and available amenities is already stated in our listing details, including that we do not provide personal toiletries such as toothpaste and toothbrushes.

The villa I stayed in this time was exactly as shown in the photos, and in fact, the actual place was even more stunning than the photos!Everyone was excited as soon as they walked in; it was truly beautiful.The house manager, Dando, was friendly and considerate throughout. The only downside is that the hot water isn't very reliable; it often runs out while I'm washing. Also, the hair dryer isn't very powerful, so it takes a long time to dry my hair.But overall, the experience was excellent. The thoughtful gesture of turning on the air conditioning in advance, especially before check-in, was a real plus. Highly recommended!

What I loved about this place - 
1) Lots of sunlight during the day 
2) Decent sized pool - pretty deep too.. I’m 163cm tall and I couldnt stand on my feet which is great cuz my husband and I love swimming
3) Spacious place - it’s a 2BR villa but we booked it just for the two of us, so we used one room as a walk-in closet and the other for sleeping. Kitchen & dining area + outdoor living space were big & spacious! 
4) I was so so worried about mosquitoes and bugs since the villa has a lot of open space, but to my surprise, I didnt get a single mosquito bite!!! 
5) Photogenic! I wish i could share here some of the amazing photos we took… so pretty.
6) Location : walkable to most places in Canggu but away from the noise..

Again, I would stay here again because of how beautiful and central it is but it does have its hiccups.
reviews.hostResponse:

The hotspot was provided as a temporary solution, and we're currently working on upgrading the Wi-Fi by adding an additional unit to ensure better coverage and speed throughout the villa.
As for the hot water, after checking, it is functioning normally—please note that it may take around 30 seconds for the water to heat up properly. We’ll make sure to communicate this more clearly to future guests.
Lastly, thank you for mentioning the microwave—we currently don’t provide one, but your suggestion is noted and we will consider adding it in the future to improve our amenities.
We truly value your comments and are glad to hear you’d still consider staying with us again. We hope to welcome you back with an even better experience next time!

shortDesc: Biarkan diri Anda terhanyut dalam kehangatan nuansa gurun pasir yang eksotis di jantung Canggu. Nikmati kesegaran berenang di bawah sinar mentari tropis dan sensasi mandi terbuka bernuansa spa alami yang merelaksasi setiap jengkal tubuh Anda.
description: Biarkan diri Anda terhanyut dalam kehangatan nuansa gurun pasir yang eksotis di jantung Canggu. Nikmati kesegaran berenang di bawah sinar mentari tropis dan sensasi mandi terbuka bernuansa spa alami yang merelaksasi setiap jengkal tubuh Anda.
fullDesc:
Temukan pelarian eksotis bernuansa padang pasir yang menawan di Khaleela Villas. Membawa inspirasi oasis gurun ke tengah semaraknya Canggu, villa 2 kamar tidur satu lantai ini menawarkan ketenangan visual yang jarang ditemui di tempat lain.

Dinding bernuansa terakota hangat dan lengkungan kurva khas timur tengah berpadu anggun dengan tanaman kaktus dan kolam renang pribadi yang jernih. Kamar mandi terbuka tropis dengan shower pancuran batu alam menghadirkan ritual mandi yang menyegarkan jiwa di bawah langit terbuka Bali.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"Desainnya luar biasa memukau dan sangat menenangkan! Konsep oasis gurunnya sangat unik, stafnya sangat ramah dan sigap, dan lokasinya dekat dengan kafe-kafe favorit di Canggu. Liburan yang sangat menyenangkan!"

Hanya beberapa menit berkendara dari pantai selancar Batu Bolong dan Echo Beach, Khaleela Villas adalah tempat di mana estetika fotografi dan kenyamanan relaksasi berpadu sempurna.

descriptionSections.body: Discover Khaleela Villas, a desert-inspired oasis in vibrant Canggu. Its unique charm captivates with immersive desert vibes. This single-story haven boasts two cozy bedrooms for a serene retreat. Lounge by the refreshing pool, basked in sunlight. The fully equipped kitchen beckons culinary adventures. Unwind in the comfy living area, or bathe outdoors in harmony with nature. Find tranquility amidst the desert design, ensuring an unforgettable stay in Canggu.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
Khaleela Villas is a desert-inspired sanctuary located in the bustling area of Canggu. The villa's unique design exudes the charm of the desert, creating a captivating and immersive experience. The single-story layout features two bedrooms, providing a comfortable and peaceful retreat for your stay.

The villa offers a refreshing swimming pool where you can cool off and unwind under the sun. The fully equipped kitchen provides all the necessary amenities for your culinary adventures. The comfortable living area is the perfect space to relax and unwind, while the outdoor shower allows you to connect with nature and enjoy a refreshing bathing experience.

Khaleela Villas offers a tranquil escape with its desert-inspired design and soothing pool views, providing a unique and unforgettable stay in Canggu.

descriptionSections.title: Guest access
descriptionSections.body: The villa and pool will be reserved for you. There will be a host who will be your contact person during your stay. We have a team of housekeeping, a gardener, and a pool boy to ensure that the villa is in pristine condition.

descriptionSections.title: Other things to note
descriptionSections.body:
There is construction next door on the doorstep from 8 AM - 5 PM. It is hard to say if there will be noise during your stay.

Due to the possible daytime noise we are offering reduced rates. If it is too noisy for you during your stay, you can cancel your stay, and we will refund the nights you have not been staying.

Please adhere to the booking rules. The villa cannot be occupied by more guests than booked. Host approval is required for professional photography and additional terms may apply.

Friendly note
To comply with Indonesian government regulations, guests are required to complete and sign a short check-in form upon arrival and may be asked to present a valid ID. The form also includes house rules and the property's terms and conditions. By confirming your booking, you agree to this process during your stay.

The doorman at the entrance were starting chatting at 7am with his friends that were probably visiting him… which makes it very not likeable knowing bathrooms where open and that it was right in front of doorman’s watching room.
The workers of the villa also were coming to make themselves a coffee or to have a drink in the pool house.
Cleaning was good ! Except the fact they wanted to charge us bed sheets because they got dirty… which was a bit confusing.
No lighting upstairs and fans weren’t working. Which made the rooftop unsuitable.
Very nice modern house !! I loved it.
It’s a shame it’s poorly maintained.
reviews.hostResponse:
Dear Rose,
Thank you for your feedback. While we’re glad you enjoyed the villa and its modern amenities, we need to clarify several points. The AC units are cleaned regularly, typically once a month, and no request was made during your stay to adjust this schedule. All AC units are now functioning properly. Our staff enter the villa only at agreed times with guests, and any perceived intrusion does not reflect a deviation from this policy. Regarding the bed sheets, the charge was applied due to a permanent mark caused by a tattoo, which made the sheets unusable; this fee remains valid despite it not being paid until today. The lighting and fans upstairs have now been repaired, and the rooftop is fully functional. We are proud to say that the villa is maintained very well. While we value guest input, we expect reviews to reflect the complete situation. Thank you.

- toilet rolls not replenished 
- kitchen bins not emptied 
- staff did not know how to operate the projector

- first room on the first floor had issues with the lock, my friend was stuck in the room for 1.5h which disrupted our plans 
Overall I felt that for paying a premium price, the service was not satisfactory
reviews.hostResponse:
Dear Kylethan,
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We value all guest comments, as they help us maintain and improve our standards.
After reviewing the points raised, we’d like to offer some clarification. The air conditioning unit was not leaking; there was minor ice buildup, but it continued to function properly and has since been fully resolved. Our team performs thorough daily cleaning and replaces towels, amenities, and bin liners regularly. These services are not carried out multiple times a day unless specifically requested, to ensure guests’ privacy and comfort are respected during their stay.
The projector was fully functional, and our staff are always available to assist with its operation. Guests are welcome to reach out at any time for additional service or support, and our team is always happy to help.
Regarding communication, we always strive to respond as promptly as possible; however, please understand that response times may be slightly delayed during nighttime hours. As for the door issue, our villa manager responded within eight minutes and provided prompt assistance. The lock jam occurred after the mechanism was forced, but it was resolved in under an hour.
We appreciate the opportunity to clarify these details. While we regret that certain aspects of your experience did not meet expectations, we believe it’s important to ensure accurate information is shared. Our team remains committed to providing attentive service and a comfortable stay for every guest.

Thank you for your feedback. We are committed to maintaining high standards and will continue to strive for excellence.

description: Rasakan masa depan liburan mewah di mana kecanggihan teknologi berpadu dengan kemegahan tropis. Bersantailah di rooftop jacuzzi, nikmati bioskop proyektor luar ruangan, dan dengarkan alunan musik jernih dari sistem suara Sonos di seluruh sudut villa.
fullDesc:
Selamat datang di Beyond the Palms, villa 4 kamar tidur berteknologi tinggi paling spektakuler di Canggu. Dirancang bagi pelancong modern yang menginginkan hiburan kelas atas, privasi total, dan kemewahan arsitektur tanpa kompromi.

Masuki gerbang villa dan Anda langsung disambut taman tropis megah dengan kolam renang seluas 45 meter persegi. Di dalam, nikmati TV 4K Smart 86 inci dengan sound system Sonos, dapur gourmet lengkap dengan peralatan SMEG, dan proyektor bioskop luar ruangan. Puncaknya adalah rooftop terrace yang dilengkapi jacuzzi hangat dan dek yoga dengan panorama matahari terbenam yang memukau.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"Villa terbaik yang pernah kami sewa di Bali! Hiburannya luar biasa lengkap—dari jacuzzi di rooftop, sound system Sonos di setiap ruangan, hingga bioskop outdoor. Staf dan keamanannya sangat profesional. Pengalaman yang tak terlupakan!"

Amankan pengalaman liburan paling canggih dan menyenangkan di Bali sekarang juga bersama keluarga dan sahabat terbaik Anda.

descriptionSections.body:
Welcome to Beyond the Palms!

This luxurious, high-tech 4-bedroom villa is perfect for anyone who wants a truly unforgettable Bali experience. We've designed it with privacy, comfort, and fun in mind. Whether you're a group of friends, a family, or a couple, you'll absolutely love everything Beyond the Palms has to offer.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
As you step into Beyond the Palms, you're instantly greeted by a massive garden area that leads to a stunning, crystal-clear 45sqm swimming pool. Relax on the sunbeds, play your favorite music through the outdoor speakers, take a refreshing swim, and make the most of your well-deserved break.
Enjoy a good BBQ? The outdoor area offers a private grill area just steps from the pool. It's the perfect place to prepare memorable meals and share them with your friends and family on the beautiful Bali evenings.

Step inside, head upstairs, and be wowed by the spacious living area. Huge panoramic windows offer amazing sunset views, best enjoyed from your extra comfy sofa. Not a big fan of sunsets? Enjoy your favorite movie on the premium 86-inch 4K Smart TV with its crystal-clear SONOS sound.

Cooking enthusiasts will love the fully equipped, state-of-the-art kitchen, complete with high-end appliances, SMEG gadgets, and a large island bench—perfect for creating culinary delights and enjoying them with loved ones.

The villa’s centerpiece is the terrace area, a guest favorite. Chill out on the huge sofa, watch movies on the projector with incredible surround sound, or unwind in the premium jacuzzi. And for those who enjoy staying active, the terrace’s yoga deck provides a tranquil space, especially magical during sunset.

descriptionSections.title: Guest access
descriptionSections.body: Guests have exclusive access to all areas of the villa. Entry is seamless with an electronic code provided by our concierge during check-in.

descriptionSections.title: Other things to note
descriptionSections.body:
Beyond the Palms is located in Canggu, close to all the best that Bali has to offer: 
5 min to Pepito (Grocery store)
5 min to Bali MMA and Wanderlust fitness village
6 min to Obsidian Gym
12 min to Finns Beach Club & Atlas club
13 min to Berawa Beach


**Parking Space**
Beyond the Palms offers a dedicated parking space with enough room for one car and several motorbikes.


** Tech You'll Love**
-  Multi-room audio system (indoor and outdoor)
-  High-speed Wi-Fi with amplifiers
-  86-inch 4K Smart TV in the living room with SONOS speaker
-  65-inch 4K Smart TV in the master bedroom with SONOS speaker
-  55-inch 4K Smart TVs in guest bedrooms
-  Projector with audio speakers & subwoofers
-  Premium kitchen appliances and SMEG gadgets
-  Jacuzzi

*** Privacy & Security ***
Guests' privacy is a top priority at Beyond the Palms, which is projected by villa designers and well-honored by the villa staff. For your extra safety, there is all-night security.

Please be advised that private chef services at the villa may only be arranged through our management team or with our prior written consent.

**Please note that there is construction work next door, which may cause some noise disturbance. This is expected to continue until the end of July 2027**

fullDesc:
Raih kedamaian batin di Villa Akar, sebuah karya arsitektur kontemporer oleh Teduh yang meraih predikat prestisius Guest Favorite dengan ulasan sempurna bintang 5.0 di Airbnb.

Terletak di salah satu kantong paling tenang di Berawa, villa 4 kamar tidur ini menawarkan fleksibilitas luar biasa: ruang keluarga dan ruang makan ber-AC dapat ditutup rapat untuk kenyamanan sejuk, atau dibuka lebar-lebar untuk menyatu dengan angin sepoi tropis dan kolam renang asri. Empat kamar tidur utama en-suite menjamin privasi maksimal bagi seluruh anggota keluarga.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"Pantas saja mendapat predikat Guest Favorite 5.0! Villanya sangat terawat, pencahayaan alaminya luar biasa, dan tim staf selalu hadir dengan senyum hangat membantu segala kebutuhan kami. Dekat pantai dan kafe-kafe lezat!"

Izinkan diri Anda merasakan standar baru kenyamanan liburan di Berawa bersama tim pelayanan yang berdedikasi tinggi.

descriptionSections.body:
Discover Villa Akar, a contemporary four-bedroom villa set in one of Berawa’s most desirable pockets.

What awaits you:

- An unbeatable location near the beach and Berawa’s best hotspots
- Modern living spaces filled with natural light
- A dedicated team ensuring comfort from check-in to checkout

A refined Berawa stay, made effortless.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
Villa Akar by Teduh is part of a curated collection of premium private villas in Berawa, Bali, designed for guests seeking privacy, design-led comfort, and a more elevated Bali stay. 

This polished four-bedroom hideaway set in the very heart of Berawa. Your arrival begins with the villa’s signature feature: a long, graceful pool that immediately captures your attention, its wide steps and sun loungers creating a natural place to settle in and unwind.

Just beside the pool, the main building opens into an elegant open-plan living area. The kitchen, dining space, and cozy lounge are arranged in one seamless sweep, framed by tall glass doors that can be fully opened to embrace the tropical breeze or closed to create a cool, quiet interior. The space is designed for easy living—perfect for relaxed mornings, shared meals, or evenings spent watching movies while surrounded by greenery and calming pool views.

Every bedroom at Villa Akar is designed with privacy and comfort in mind, each paired with its own en suite bathroom. The primary suite on the ground floor overlooks the pool and features a refined layout with a spacious bathroom and bathtub. The remaining bedrooms are positioned upstairs for added seclusion, including a second master suite that also enjoys the luxury of its own bathtub.

Blending understated elegance with a serene atmosphere and an unbeatable Berawa address, Villa Akar offers a luxurious setting for families and friends looking to enjoy a distinguished Bali retreat.

descriptionSections.title: Guest access
descriptionSections.body: Guests will be able to access the entire villa and have full privacy.

descriptionSections.title: Other things to note
descriptionSections.body:
Included in every stay:
-Free welcome drink
-Villa’s staff with daily cleaning, and pool & garden maintenance 2/3 times per week
-Bath & Pool towels for each guests
-Hi Speed Wifi internet connection
-Safety boxes
-Concierge Services

Available upon request through our exclusive Concierge services:
-Airport transfer
-Car rental (with/without driver)
-Bike rental
-Breakfast upon request
-Private cook
-Massages at the villa
-Nanny services
-Pool fence
-Laundry
-Restaurant bookings
-Activities such as watersports, surf classes, cooking classes, water parks…
-Daily tours to visit temples, landscapes, villages…
-And much more!

Don’t hesitate to ask us if you want to do some activities or visits while enjoying your stay at our villa!

*Please note that there is nearby construction work, which may occasionally cause noise disturbance. This is expected to continue until the end of November 2026*

Dear Ariza,
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We’re glad to hear that you found the villa beautiful and felt the price offered good value.
We’re sorry to hear about the inconveniences you experienced during your stay. As Bali is a tropical island, it is common to encounter mosquitoes and other insects, especially during certain seasons. However, we’ve taken proactive steps to ensure our guests’ comfort, including providing mosquito spray in the rooms and carrying out regular fogging and spraying to minimize their presence. We are also working continuously to manage any natural odors around the property.
Regarding your concern about safety, we want to reassure you that CCTV cameras are already installed and positioned to face the exterior of the villa, in line with guest privacy standards. We have not received any complaints or reports related to robbery during your stay or from other guests previously, and the area is generally considered safe. shortDesc: Kemudahan akses gaya hidup premium Berawa berada tepat di depan pintu Anda. Berada persis di seberang FINNS Recreation Club, villa 2 kamar modern chic ini menyuguhkan interior menawan dan kolam renang privat yang memanjakan liburan Anda.
description: Kemudahan akses gaya hidup premium Berawa berada tepat di depan pintu Anda. Berada persis di seberang FINNS Recreation Club, villa 2 kamar modern chic ini menyuguhkan interior menawan dan kolam renang privat yang memanjakan liburan Anda.
fullDesc:
Nikmati kenyamanan tinggal di titik nol gaya hidup Berawa. Villa Golden terletak tepat di seberang FINNS Recreation Club, memberikan Anda akses instan ke arena olahraga terbaik, kafe kelas dunia, waterpark, dan lapangan tenis, sembari tetap menikmati privasi villa pribadi Anda.

Villa 2 kamar tidur bergaya modern chic ini memancarkan pesona interior mewah dengan sentuhan kayu hangat dan marmer elegan. Kedua kamar tidur memiliki kamar mandi en-suite berkelas, dan ruang tamu terbuka mengarah langsung ke kolam renang pribadi yang jernih.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"Lokasi yang sangat sempurna di Berawa! Tinggal menyeberang jalan sudah sampai di FINNS Club, sangat dekat dengan kafe-kafe trendi. Villanya bersih berkilau, kolam renangnya sejuk, dan stafnya sangat membantu!"

Pilihan ideal bagi pasangan atau sahabat yang ingin menikmati dinamika terbaik Berawa tanpa repot bermacet-macetan.

descriptionSections.body:
Nestled in the vibrant Berawa neighborhood, Villa Golden offers a luxurious retreat for discerning travelers.

What to expect:
- Beautiful design and architecture
- located just across from FINNS recreation club
- Literally in the heart of Canggu, few meters away from all the best Canggu cafes and restaurants

The villa is fully equipped and staffed so you don't have to worry about a thing!

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
Experience the epitome of luxury living at Villa Golden, a meticulously designed 2-bedroom en-suite villa perfectly situated in the heart of Berawa, directly facing the renowned FINNS recreation club. 

Upon entering Villa Golden, guests are greeted by a chic and inviting atmosphere, with contemporary furnishings and tasteful decor adorning the spacious interior. Each of the two bedrooms features its own en-suite bathroom, offering privacy and comfort for all guests. 

The villa's fully equipped kitchen provides a haven for culinary enthusiasts, complete with modern appliances and ample countertop space. Whether you're whipping up a quick breakfast or preparing a gourmet feast, the kitchen caters to all your culinary needs.

The stylish living areas are ideal for relaxation and entertainment, featuring comfortable sunken seating arrangements and state-of-the-art entertainment systems. Floor-to-ceiling windows allow for abundant natural light, creating a bright and airy ambiance throughout the villa.

In addition to its impeccable interior, Villa Golden offers the convenience of dedicated staff members who provide daily cleaning services, ensuring that your stay is as effortless as it is indulgent.

Step outside to discover the villa's private outdoor space, where a tranquil oasis awaits. Lounge by the sparkling pool, unwind in the cozy seating area, ideal for moments of relaxation and contemplation amidst nature's beauty.

Located in a bustling neighborhood just steps away from FINNS recreation club, Villa Golden offers easy access to an array of dining, shopping, and entertainment options. Whether you're seeking relaxation or adventure, this exquisite villa provides the perfect base for exploring all that Berawa has to offer.

Indulge in the ultimate luxury getaway at Villa Golden, where every detail has been meticulously crafted to ensure an unforgettable experience of refined elegance and unparalleled comfort.

descriptionSections.title: Guest access
descriptionSections.body: Guests will be able to access the entire villa and have full privacy.

descriptionSections.title: Other things to note
descriptionSections.body:
Included in every stay:

- Free welcome drink
- Villa staff with daily cleaning, and pool & garden maintenance 2/3 times per week
- Bath & Pool towels for each guests
- Hi Speed Wi-Fi internet connection
- Safety boxes
- Concierge Services

Available upon request through our exclusive Concierge services:

- Airport transfer
- Car rental (with/without driver)
- Bike rental
- Breakfast upon request 
- Private cook
- Massages at the villa
- Nanny services
- Pool Fence
- Laundry
- Restaurant bookings
- Activities such as watersports, surf classes, cooking classes, water parks…
- Daily tours to visit temples, landscapes, villages…
- And much more!

Don’t hesitate to ask us if you want to do some activities or visits while enjoying your stay at our villa!

reviews.comment: The place was great, very spacious and beautiful and the vibes were on a 100. reviews.name: Manish
reviews.comment:
The villa is absolutely beautiful, one of the most beautiful places I’ve ever stayed in. The host is very warm and welcoming. The house is extremely well equipped and had everything we needed: first-aid supplies, filtered drinking water, bathrobes, TVs and tissues in every room, and hairdryers in each room.
When we arrived, the pool was dirty and not functional due to previous guests, but to the host’s credit, it was cleaned and fixed the very next day. Still had some algae tho!
The property itself feels run down in several areas. Shower pressure and water flow were extremely poor in some rooms, with visible mold in the shower grout. There was also a leaking tap trap and dirty bedding in one room on arrival-issues that should have been resolved before check-in.
The biggest issue, however, is the location. The access roads are in very poor condition- so bad that cabs cannot reach the villa requiring a ~200 m walk with luggage, which is highly inconvenient.
reviews.hostResponse:
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback, Manish. We’re delighted to hear that you found the villa beautiful and appreciated the warm welcome and the well-equipped amenities.
We sincerely apologize for the issues during your stay. We take these matters seriously and are reviewing our maintenance and housekeeping procedures to prevent similar issues in the future.
Regarding the villa’s access, the road is still unpaved, but cars can reach the property. We understand that the condition of the road may feel inconvenient, and we always advise guests so they can plan accordingly.
We truly value your feedback, as it helps us improve, and we hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back under even better conditions.

GUYS YOU SHOULD STAY HERE 100%. If you want to relax, this is a good place.
reviews.hostResponse: Thank you so much for your wonderful review, Fadhli! We are absolutely delighted that you enjoyed your stay with us. We look forward to creating more great moments for you during your next visit.

reviews.originalComment:
Prachtige villa om te verblijven met elkaar. Mooi ingericht, ruime kamers, heerlijke badkamer.
Als je gaat: laat een avond een kok komen! Dat was een feestje, super lekker gegeten.
Het is wel lastig om hier te komen. Onverhard pad en auto’s (taxi’s) zetten je op de weg af, laatste stukje lopen.
Tip voor de eigenaar: vervang de stoelen bij de eettafel. Rugleuningen zijn helemaal doorgebogen.
reviews.hostResponse:
Dear Aafje,

reviews.name: Mania

reviews.name: Phillip
reviews.comment:
The team communicated well, but I strongly advise against booking this property. The house is completely run down: bedding and towels had heavy stains, the bathroom reeked of a disgusting smell, and water problems were constant — including no water at times and dirty water from the tap.
The windows have huge gaps, and worst of all, there is zero privacy. Farmers and children regularly walk directly past the bedroom and pool, staring in. You cannot relax here — there is no privacy anywhere on this property.
This place is not suitable for guests and should not be listed in its current condition
reviews.hostResponse:
Hi Philip,
Thank you for sharing your feedback. We’re pleased you appreciated our team’s communication and regret the inconveniences you encountered during your stay.
The water disruption was caused by an area-wide electricity outage beyond our control, and normal supply resumed as soon as the issue was resolved. Regarding privacy, the villa’s open design; which many guests value for its views of the rice fields; is located in a traditional Balinese area where occasional passersby can be seen. We’ve recently added a bamboo fence to improve seclusion, and our team monitors it to help maintain guest comfort.
We conduct thorough checks on bedding, towels, plumbing, and overall cleanliness before each arrival and act promptly on any concerns raised during a stay. While most guests enjoy the villa’s open layout and peaceful surroundings, we’ll take your comments into consideration to see where we can further enhance the experience.
Thank you again for your input; it helps us continue improving for our guests.

reviews.comment: Charming villa, Surge means paradise and the feeling is just like waking up in paradise. An oasis of peace from the chaos of Ubud with a suggestive view of the rice fields and a pleasant and very long pool. We will happily return.

reviews.comment: The villa we stayed in has a good view, but it takes 3 minutes to walk from the car.The housekeeper responded promptly and arranged spa services for us.Because it is surrounded by fields, there are more insects, there are gaps under the door of the room, there are flying insects in the house, the spray in the 3rd bedroom is small, and the sheets have yellow stains, which is very unacceptable.Due to the late arrival on the night of check-in, when the housekeeper was introducing the house to me, I answered 2 phone calls in a row, and I could see that the housekeeper was a little impatient, but the time problem was understandable.Everything else is fine.
reviews.originalComment: 入住的别墅景观很好，只是下车后需要步行3分钟才能到达。管家响应及时，为我们安排了spa服务。因为周围是田野，所以虫子较多，房间的门下有缝隙，屋子里有飞虫，第3间卧室的喷洒水流很小，床单有黄色污渍，这是非常不能接受的。由于入住当天晚上到达晚了些，管家在和我介绍房子的时候，我连续接通了2个电话，能看出管家有一点不耐烦，但时间问题可以理解。其它都还好。

reviews.name: Pierre-Olivier
reviews.comment:
The owner mentioned in his listing that "farmers may be required to cultivate their rice field in front of the house"
We came across workers building a wall by the pool.
As soon as we wake up and open the curtains of our rooms, we are face to face with several people who work AT THE EDGE of your pool and look at you throughout the day. So no privacy, impossible for us to relax, impossible for my wife to put on a swimsuit, etc.
These workers are not aggressive but when you rent a private house it's to relax and have privacy!
We left after the 1st night because it was impossible for us to relax and have a decent vacation.
This is a shame because the villa and its pool are very pretty even if difficult to access.
We are still waiting for the refund of the nights following this inconvenience but we have not received any compensation to date
reviews.originalComment:
Le propriétaire mentionné dans son annonce que « des agriculteurs peuvent être amenés à cultiver leur rizière devant la maison »
Nous sommes tombés sur des travailleurs qui montaient un mur au bord de la piscine .
Dès le réveil en ouvrant les rideaux de nos chambres , nous moles nez à nez avec plusieurs personnes qui travaillent AU BORD de votre piscine et vous regarde tout au long de la journée . Donc aucune intimité , impossible pour nous de se détendre , impossible pour ma femme de se mettre en maillot de bain,…
Ces travailleurs ne sont pas agressifs mais quand vous louez une maison privative c’est pour se détendre et avoir de l’intimité !
Nous sommes partis après la 1ere nuit car il était impossible pour nous de nous détendre et passez des vacances convenables.
Cela est dommage car la villa et sa piscine sont très jolies même si difficile d’accès .
Nous sommes toujours en attente du remboursement des nuites suite à ce désagrément mais nous n’avons à ce jour reçu aucun dédommagement
reviews.hostResponse:
Hi Pierre, we’d like to clarify the situation you mentioned. The work you observed was on the irrigation area next to the rice field, which is essential for local farmers and outside the villa grounds. The workers were never inside the villa, and the property has remained private and secure at all times. This was a temporary, short-term situation and has since been completed.
The villa and pool are fully private for guests to enjoy, and this was an exceptional occurrence. We’re glad you recognized the villa’s beauty, and we are confident that future guests will experience the relaxing stay that we are known for.

reviews.name: Hugo
reviews.comment:
The villa is amazing, exactly as shown in the pictures. The pool is great and the whole thing overlooks the rice fields. We are completely disconnected and in a peaceful bubble. The beds are like real clouds, the showers have pressure (important detail in Bali). Cleaning is done every day, breakfast is prepared for you at the villa, we even got massaged at the villa. They are accommodating +++: we arrived early and everything was ready. They organized our excursion to Mount Batur for us. The staff is great, very responsive, they even contacted us after we left because we had forgotten some things.
Really nothing to complain about, it was perfect, I was really sad to leave!
Thanks for everything, Sophie, Hugo and their friends 😊
reviews.originalComment:
La villa est incroyable, exactement comme sur les photos. La piscine est top et l’ensemble donne sur les rizières. On est complètement déconnectés et dans une bulle paisible. Les lits sont de vrais nuages, les douches ont de la pression (détail important à Bali). Le ménage est fait tous les jours, le petit dej est préparé pour vous à la villa, on s’est même fait masser à la villa. Ils sont arrangeant +++ : on est arrivés en avance et tout était prêt. Is ont organisés pour nous notre excursion au mont Batur. Le staff est top, très réactif, ils nous ont même recontactés après être partis car on avait oublié des affaires.
Vraiment rien à redire, c’était parfait, j’étais vraiment triste de partir !
Merci pour tout, Sophie, Hugo et leurs amis 😊

reviews.name: ⁨Natalie B.⁩
reviews.comment:
We have really enjoyed our stay at Surga Villa. The path there had crashed, due to rain, and made up a smaller waterfall. It was a bit uncomfortable, and at the end of the holiday, some set up a street lamp so you could see where you went in the dark. TTD 'was upon arrival, and departure very helpful in driving suitcases the rest of the way on moped.
Nice house, nice pool. Perfect for swimming, sunbathing and relaxing. As others have mentioned, the house is very open and farmers walk along the edge of the pool. We could put it down, but at first it seemed a little quirky. One single ranger was especially hugely cozy when he stuck his head by :) 
Close to town/markets that were not far to the smaller supermarkets and restaurants. 
TTD 'made a lot of their service and they certainly went an extra mile to meet needs and wishes :) We are trying out another city, on the next trip to Bali. But we would not hesitate to come to the villa again in Ubud. Thank you for a wonderful stay < 3
reviews.originalComment:
Vi har virkelig nydt vores ophold i Surga Villa. Stien derhen var styrtet sammen, grundet regn, og udgjorde et mindre vandfald. Det var lidt ubehageligt, og først sidst på ferien satte nogle en gadelampe op, så man i mørket kunne se hvor man gik. TTD' var ved ankomst, og afgang meget behjælpelige med at få kørt kufferter resten af vejen på knallert.
Flot hus, lækker pool. Perfekt til svømmeture, solbadning og afslapning. Som andre har nævnt er huset meget åbent, og der kommer landmænd gående langs poolkanten. Vi kunne godt lægge det fra os, men i starten virkede det lidt spøjst. En enkelt genganger var især enormt hyggelig, når han stak hovedet forbi :)
Tæt på byen/markeder, der var ikke langt til de mindre supermarkeder og restauranter.
TTD' gjorde meget ud af deres service, og de gik bestemt en ekstra mil for at opfylde behov og ønsker :) Vi afprøver en anden by, ved næste tur til Bali. Men vi ville ikke tøve med at komme til villaen igen i Ubud. Tak for et dejligt ophold <3
reviews.hostResponse:
Hello Natalie,

fullDesc:
Ketika Anda melangkahkan kaki melewati gapura batu tradisional Bali di Villa Surga, Anda seketika tahu bahwa Anda telah tiba di tempat yang istimewa. Sesuai namanya, villa ini adalah surga privat di mana keheningan alam Ubud menjadi pelindung Anda dari kepenatan dunia.

Menghadirkan 4 kamar tidur luas dengan kamar mandi terbuka en-suite, villa ini dirancang untuk menyerap keindahan alam sekitarnya. Infinity pool pribadi membentang menghadap lembah hijau tropis yang rimbun, menjadi tempat terbaik untuk bermeditasi, membaca buku, atau sekadar berendam menikmati udara segar pegunungan.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"Ketenangan yang sesungguhnya di Ubud! Pemandangan lembah hijaunya begitu menenangkan mata dan jiwa. Seluruh staf melayani kami dengan tulus dari hati, menyiapkan sarapan lezat, dan menjaga villa tetap bersih berkilau. Liburan yang sangat damai!"

Rasakan keajaiban spiritual dan kenyamanan total di jantung budaya Bali bersama orang-orang tercinta Anda.

descriptionSections.body:
Welcome to Villa Surga, a private 4-bedroom villa tucked into the lush surroundings of Ubud — ideal for families and groups seeking space, comfort, and a peaceful tropical setting close to Bali’s cultural heart.

The villa features a private swimming pool, generous shared living areas, and full villa staffing, allowing you to relax from the moment you arrive. Whether you’re here to slow down, explore Ubud, or spend quality time together, it offers a calm and comfortable base for your stay.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
Enter through a traditional Balinese gate into your own secluded sanctuary, designed for easy living and relaxation.

The villa includes four spacious bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bathroom, offering privacy and comfort for every guest. Bedrooms are thoughtfully furnished with plush bedding, ample storage, air conditioning, and soft lighting to ensure restful nights. The en-suite bathrooms feature modern finishes, rain showers, and quality bath amenities.

At the center of the villa is the private swimming pool, surrounded by a sun deck where guests can relax, swim, or enjoy quiet moments throughout the day.

The open-plan living area provides a comfortable space for gathering, with generous seating and a relaxed indoor-outdoor layout. A fully equipped kitchen allows you to prepare meals at your convenience, or you may arrange a private cook through our concierge for an effortless dining experience.

High-speed Wi-Fi is available throughout the villa, making it suitable for both leisure stays and remote work when needed.

Villa Surga is especially well-suited for families or groups of friends who value privacy, shared spaces, and a tranquil environment while remaining within easy reach of Ubud’s temples, cafés, and cultural attractions.

Please note: local farmers may occasionally pass along a nearby footpath to access rice fields, offering an authentic glimpse into daily Balinese life.

fullDesc:
Bayangkan Anda melangkah masuk ke dalam mahakarya arsitektur tropis di mana batas antara alam dan kemewahan modern melebur sempurna. Dirancang oleh Biombo Architects yang tersohor, House Terra bukan sekadar villa—ini adalah tempat perlindungan pribadi Anda di Pererenan yang dirancang untuk mengembalikan ketenangan batin Anda.

Begitu Anda menginjakkan kaki di atas lantai batu alam yang sejuk, gemericik air kolam renang pribadi dan aroma frangipani seketika menyambut indera Anda, menghapus segala penat perjalanan. Dengan 5 kamar tidur en-suite yang luas, ruang santai beralaskan kayu jati hangat, piano klasik, dan area lounge outdoor yang teduh, setiap sudut dirancang untuk menciptakan momen tak terlupakan bersama keluarga dan sahabat tercinta.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"Sebuah mahakarya arsitektur di Pererenan di mana setiap detail memancarkan kemewahan yang effortless dan kedamaian total. Kolam renang, ruang terbuka yang lapang, dan kehangatan tim staf membuat liburan Bali kami benar-benar sempurna. Nilai 10 dari 10!"

Ketika Anda memilih tinggal di House Terra, Anda mengamankan privasi eksklusif di lokasi paling diminati di Pererenan—hanya beberapa menit berjalan kaki dari kafe artisan terbaik dan pesisir pantai eksotis, namun terisolasi damai dari kebisingan dunia luar.

descriptionSections.body:
Welcome to your dream getaway in the heart of Pererenan, House Terra.  
This stunning 5-bedroom villa epitomizes tropical luxury, offering an exquisite blend of comfort, style, and modern amenities. 
Whether you're seeking a serene retreat or an opulent base for exploring the vibrant culture of Bali, House Terra promises an unforgettable experience.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
Nestled in the heart of Pererenan, House Terra is a luxurious 5-bedroom villa offering a harmonious blend of modern elegance and natural beauty. This exquisite escape is designed for relaxation and rejuvenation, making it the perfect destination for your Bali getaway.

The villa features five bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms, ensuring privacy and comfort for all guests. Four bedrooms are furnished with plush king-size beds, while the fifth is ideal for families or groups with its two single beds and bunk beds. Each bedroom is tastefully designed with soft, inviting décor and ample natural light, creating a tranquil and restful ambiance.

House Terra boasts thoughtfully designed indoor and outdoor areas to elevate your stay.
A cozy space with a large TV, a plush sofa for lounging, and even a piano for musical moments. This room also doubles as an additional sleeping area if needed.
Seamlessly blending indoor and outdoor living, the open-plan design invites you to relax in style while staying connected to the lush surroundings.
The centerpiece of the villa is the private pool, bordered by tropical greenery. Adjacent to the pool, you’ll find a BBQ area with cozy seating, perfect for al fresco dining or unwinding with loved ones.

Equipped with air conditioning, high-speed Wi-Fi, and a fully equipped kitchen, House Terra ensures a seamless and comfortable stay. Every detail, from high-end bathroom fixtures to luxurious bedding, has been chosen with your comfort in mind.

Located in the charming village of Pererenan, House Terra offers a serene retreat just minutes from Bali’s best attractions. Explore beautiful beaches, trendy cafes, and local markets, or enjoy the peace of the villa’s quiet surroundings.

Whether you’re basking by the pool, indulging in a BBQ, or exploring the vibrant local scene, House Terra promises a blend of comfort, luxury, and unforgettable memories.

description: Bayangkan melangkah masuk ke dalam sanctuary privat 5 kamar tidur di Canggu & Berawa. Kolam renang pribadi berkilau, interior tropis yang elegan, dan pelayanan staf berdedikasi memastikan setiap detik liburan Anda di Bali terasa begitu berharga dan memulihkan energi jiwa.
fullDesc:
Bayangkan Anda melangkah masuk ke dalam santuari tropis yang menakjubkan di mana kemewahan modern melebur sempurna dengan kehangatan keramahan Bali. Magnificent Canggu Estate – Prestigious 5BR Tropical Pool Villa in Central Canggu dirancang khusus bagi mereka yang mendambakan liburan eksklusif tanpa kompromi.

Begitu Anda membuka pintu, suasana hening dan damai seketika menyambut Anda. Kolam renang pribadi yang jernih diapit taman tropis yang rimbun, sementara ruang keluarga terbuka mengalir alami menghadirkan semilir angin sepoi yang menyejukkan. Setiap kamar tidur dilengkapi kasur king-size berstandar hotel bintang lima, linen katun premium, dan kamar mandi en-suite bertekstur batu alam yang menenangkan panca indera.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"Perfect location and place"

Ketika Anda memilih menginap di sini, Anda mengamankan privasi mutlak di salah satu kawasan paling bergengsi di Bali—hanya beberapa menit santai dari deretan kafe artisan terbaik, restoran kelas dunia, dan pesisir pantai eksotis, sembari tetap menikmati kedamaian total di oase pribadi Anda.

descriptionSections.body:
Looking for a chic retreat near the beach?

Villa Amanora is your perfect getaway! This gorgeous 5-bedroom villa offers the ideal setting for creating unforgettable memories with family or friends, just steps from the renowned Batu Belig Beach.

What you can look forward to:

- Prime location, close to the most happening beach clubs, beach, restaurants
- Stylish, spacious and unique design 
- Brand new property

Villa Amanora comes fully equipped and staffed, ensuring a worry-free stay!

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
SPECIAL PROMO!!


Retreat to this Magnificent 5-Bedroom villa, comfortably accommodating up to 10 guests.

A beautifully designed villa located just steps from the beach, offering the ultimate blend of convenience and relaxation. Enjoy modern amenities, a private and massive pool, large chilling spaces and top-notch service.

The clever use of stone on the villa's facade makes it stunning to behold and the perfect backdrop for your photos.

Upon entry, you’ll be greeted by the lush tropical garden, where you’ll find a large private swimming pool complete with a relaxing patio and sun loungers. It's the perfect spot to unwind and soak up the sun in your own private oasis. Bring your loved ones together in the outdoor sunken area and make memories that will last a lifetime.

The spacious dining area featuring a wooden table and matching chairs. Adjacent is a fully equipped kitchen, complete with everything needed to prepare delicious meals at your leisure, or have someone prepare it for you!

The living room is outfitted with a cozy sofa, offering a beautiful view of the pool and garden, enhancing the serene and surroundings. This space includes a flat screen TV, for your entertainment.

Each bedroom features its own private bathroom and generous wardrobe space. The master bathroom even includes a beautiful black bathtub.

Stylishly decorated, the villa exudes a warm, home-like ambiance, perfect for a relaxing stay.  

The community is gated and secured by a dedicated security team, ensuring you have the safest stay possible.

descriptionSections.title: Guest access
descriptionSections.body:
The whole villa will be available for you with complete privacy. 

Please note that the parking area only fit motorcycle and one car.

descriptionSections.title: Other things to note
descriptionSections.body:
Included in every stay:
• Free welcome drink
• Villa’s staff with daily cleaning, and pool & garden maintenance 2/3 times per week
• Bath & Pool towels for each guests
• Hi Speed Wi-Fi internet connection
• Safety box
• Concierge Services

Available upon request through our exclusive Concierge services:
• Airport transfer
• Car rental (with/without driver)
• Bike rental
• Breakfast upon request
• Private cook
• Massages at the villa
• Nanny services
• Pool fence
• Laundry
• Restaurant bookings
• Activities such as watersports, surf classes, cooking classes, water parks…
• Daily tours to visit temples, landscapes, villages…
• And much more! 

Don’t hesitate to ask us if you want to do some activities or visits while enjoying your stay at our villa!

*Please note that there is nearby construction work, which may occasionally cause noise disturbance. This is expected to continue until the end of August 2027.*

We had a private chef arranged by the host and were impressed with the food and all the services they provided. Thank you so much! That’s a memorable birthday celebration for me. 🙂
reviews.hostResponse:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review,
O'Niel! We are absolutely delighted that you enjoyed your stay with us. Your positive feedback warms our hearts. We look forward to creating more great moments for you during your next visit.

reviews.name: Iver Anton
reviews.comment: We had a wonderful stay and would be happy to come back. The staff were also incredibly kind and welcoming😊
reviews.hostResponse:
Thank you so much for your fantastic review, Iver! We’re absolutely thrilled to hear that you had such an epic stay with us.
We can't wait to welcome you back for another incredible experience!

reviews.name: Albert
reviews.comment: Great spot. A bit hard to enter but really spacious and nice place. Highly recommended for a large group
reviews.hostResponse: Hi Albert, We’re beyond grateful for your kind words and thrilled that your stay was everything you hoped for. We can’t wait to host you again for another memorable visit!

reviews.name: Kim
reviews.comment: Beautiful villa. Will definitely stay again.
reviews.hostResponse: Dear Kim, it’s fantastic to hear you had such a great time with us! We’re already looking forward to your next visit!

reviews.name: Lex
reviews.comment: Thank you to all the team you were all fantastic to deal with and nothing was too much for you . All the families really enjoyed the stay including our Bossman Mr Michael . Thank you again for a memorable stay .
reviews.hostResponse: Dear Lex, it’s fantastic to hear you had such a great time with us! We’re already looking forward to your next visit

reviews.name: Scott
reviews.comment: We just our family of ten stay here for a week and it was nothing short of spectacular. The villa was exceptional and the hosts couldn't do enough to make sure our stay was enjoyable. Would recommend this spot to anyone heading to Canggu!
reviews.hostResponse: Thank you so much Scott for taking the time to share your wonderful experience. We are delighted to read that you enjoyed the stay! Your kind words are much appreciated. We look forward to welcoming you back again :)

reviews.name: Anastasia
reviews.comment: An incredibly beautiful villa, exactly as shown in photos! Perfect for large groups. We were blown away by how spacious, clean and comfortable this place was. It rained during our stay so we didn’t get to use the pool much but still a great amenity. As other reviews have indicated our only complaint was the open kitchen and living room that offers no air conditioning, otherwise we could not find any other fault with our stay. Staff and security were lovely and always eager to assist. Conveniently located with lots of stores and restaurants nearby!
reviews.hostResponse: Thank you for the lovely review, Anastasia! We’re so glad you enjoyed your stay and found the villa to be just perfect 😉 We’ve noted your suggestion for future improvements and can’t wait to welcome you back for another wonderful stay!

reviews.name: Sarah
reviews.comment:
We had the most wonderful stay at Villa Vida. The set up of the rooms are perfect for families wishing to holiday as a larger group. The staff were so kind and accommodating and helpful. 
The Villa was super clean and throughly cleaned daily. The only fault I could find is that it was so perfectly wonderful I’m afraid it will ruin other villas for us! 
The location is very central and we could walk practically anywhere in Canggu. 
10/10. You won’t be disappointed!
reviews.hostResponse: Hi Sarah, We’re beyond grateful for your kind words and thrilled that your stay was everything you hoped for. We can’t wait to host you again for another memorable visit!

reviews.name: Jeffrey
reviews.comment:
Stayed at Villa Vida with my family of 8 adults and 2 kids. 
Positives: the location is fantastic — walking distance to several restaurants and shops. Staff are responsive and rectified minor issues quickly. 
While we had a great time overall, the stay was not perfect. As other reviewers have pointed out, there is no air conditioning in the living and dining rooms. While this open concept is normal for Bali, we found the villa suffered from a lack of natural breeze in these common areas. The dining room in particular was uncomfortably warm (even at night), despite all ceilings fans running at full speed. There is a TV room on the 2nd floor which I am certain no one ever uses as it is too warm.
I would still recommend Villa Vida to friends, but with a slight caution for the reasons mentioned.
reviews.hostResponse:
Dear Jeffrey,
We’re glad to hear you had an overall enjoyable stay. As Bali is a tropical island, it can indeed get quite hot at times. We’ve provided ceiling fans in the living room for added comfort, and we truly appreciate your feedback—it’s noted for future improvements. Thank you!

reviews.name: Riley
reviews.comment: Awesome stay, second time here. Highly recommend!
reviews.hostResponse: Thanks a lot Riley! We are looking forward to host you again :)

reviews.name: Noeleen
reviews.comment: Just as the photos depict. Clean, great location, close to beach, great restaurants. Communication easy
reviews.hostResponse: Hi Noeleen, We’re beyond grateful for your kind words and thrilled that your stay was everything you hoped for. We can’t wait to host you again for another memorable visit!

reviews.name: Ciara
reviews.comment: This home was absolutely stunning! Staff was very friendly and helpful.
reviews.hostResponse: Dear Ciara, we're glad that you had a wonderful time with us. See you again soon!

reviews.name: Tessa
reviews.comment: We stayed as a large family group, and the villa was absolutely perfect for us. There were plenty of beautiful spaces that suited everyone - from toddlers to grandparents - making it easy for everyone to relax and enjoy. The villa truly has a "wow" factor, and it’s ideally located close to lots of great cafés and restaurants. While we loved exploring the local dining scene, a real highlight of our stay was having the in-villa chef (Chef Putu) - the meal was incredible, and we only wish we had arranged it earlier in our trip!
reviews.hostResponse: Thank you so much Tessa for taking the time to share your wonderful experience. We are delighted to read that you enjoyed the stay! Your kind words are much appreciated. We look forward to welcoming you back again :)

reviews.name: Jaclyn
reviews.comment:
Villa was luxurious, big and spacious. The rooms were big and can comfortably fit 20 people even though we only had 11 people. The staff were very helpful and responsive. They cleaned the apartment daily and helped us buy essentials for Nyepi Day. 
The only downside to this villa is that there is no air conditioning in the main living room, dining room and kitchen area (this is where you would typically hang out with guests). It makes it very warm and stuffy during the day and night. You could however stay cool in the pool. The rooms all had perfect air conditioning. 
The location of the villa was amazing as it was close to restaurants, cafes and beach clubs.
reviews.hostResponse:
Hello Jaclyn,
We greatly appreciate your wonderful review and suggestion! Please know that we've taken note of everything for future improvements. We can't wait to welcome you back soon! :)

reviews.name: Dana
reviews.comment:
Although this villa was extremely beautiful, the customer service was not great at all. I was communicating with one person on what’s app about an issue  and when I asked them to meet me in person, they sent someone else who didn’t know what was going on. He said that he would send a different manager over to the villa to help with my issue . When the next guy came , he said that the previous guy who had just left had been the one i was communicating with on what’s app after all. So he completely lied so that he didn’t have to take responsibility. Communication through what’s app was very slow . Takes about 30 min to a hour for response. Where as my previous villa response immediately. They couldn’t decorate the pool
With flower arrangements even though they advertise that they can on Airbnb. And to top it off the power kept cutting off . One night it was off from 11pm - 6am. Beautiful villa but non satisfactory customer service
reviews.hostResponse:
Hello Dana,
We’re glad to hear that you found the villa extremely beautiful. However, we’d like to clarify a few points you mentioned.
The pool decoration service has never been advertised on any of our platforms, as it may interfere with the pool system. That said, we’d be happy to help arrange other forms of decoration upon request.
Regarding the power outage, it was caused by an unexpected explosion at a local electrical substation—an issue that affected the entire area. We followed up with the central electrical company as quickly as possible to restore power.
Please also understand that while we're committed to assisting our guests promptly, responses via WhatsApp during nighttime may not always be immediate. We appreciate your understanding and hope to welcome you back for an even better experience in the future.

fullDesc:
Bayangkan Anda melangkah masuk ke dalam santuari tropis yang menakjubkan di mana kemewahan modern melebur sempurna dengan kehangatan keramahan Bali. Designer Beachside Villa – Ultra-Chic 4BR Coastal Retreat in Canggu dirancang khusus bagi mereka yang mendambakan liburan eksklusif tanpa kompromi.

Begitu Anda membuka pintu, suasana hening dan damai seketika menyambut Anda. Kolam renang pribadi yang jernih diapit taman tropis yang rimbun, sementara ruang keluarga terbuka mengalir alami menghadirkan semilir angin sepoi yang menyejukkan. Setiap kamar tidur dilengkapi kasur king-size berstandar hotel bintang lima, linen katun premium, dan kamar mandi en-suite bertekstur batu alam yang menenangkan panca indera.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"Beautiful villa with amazing amenities! Clean, quiet, and exactly as described in the listing. Check-in was smooth, and the host was great with communication. Would highly recommend staying here!"

Ketika Anda memilih menginap di sini, Anda mengamankan privasi mutlak di salah satu kawasan paling bergengsi di Bali—hanya beberapa menit santai dari deretan kafe artisan terbaik, restoran kelas dunia, dan pesisir pantai eksotis, sembari tetap menikmati kedamaian total di oase pribadi Anda.

descriptionSections.body:
Perfectly situated in the heart of Batu Bolong Canggu, Villa Vida offers a unique retreat just steps away from the vibrant restaurants, nightlife, shopping, and the beach. With a captivating view of picturesque rice fields, the villa promises a distinctive experience for guests seeking a harmonious blend of tranquility yet right next to some of Canggu’s main attractions. 

The villa features spacious living and dining areas, meticulously designed rooms, an incredible pool and outdoor living.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
Indulge in the perfect Balinese retreat at the luxurious Villa Vida. Admire rice field views, rich and sumptuous outdoor living, and relax by the generous swimming pool or in the sun-drenched lounging areas.

Upon entering Villa Vida, opulence unfolds in seamlessly connected open-living spaces with fans. The central hub, featuring a double-height ceiling adorned with mesmerizing skylights, offers a captivating view over the pool and garden from the extraordinary kitchen and dining area. 
The sunken living room, equipped with a 65-inch TV, effortlessly links to the pool bar area and dining space.

Villa Vida redefines luxury living with its carefully crafted 5 bedrooms, all with AC. 
Discover 3 generous master bedrooms, an expansive superior suite of 70 sqm with a private balcony, and an executive suite of 100 sqm with a large private terrace boasting stunning rice field views. Each bedroom feature beautifully appointed bathrooms while the two suites boast generously sized bathrooms with double showers and a bathtub. 
Elevate your comfort with King Koil double bed mattresses in every room, and revel in the flexibility of hosting up to 4 persons in each room with additional built-in single beds. 
Villa Vida can accommodate a maximum of 20 guests.

Pamper yourself in the separate entertainment area on the upstairs patio equipped with an additional 65-inch TV and a large comfy sofa. 
Discover in-pool sunbathing chaise lounges alongside an inviting area with sunken sunbeds in the 18m-long pool, featuring a built-in wet and dry bar area. 
Connected seamlessly to the pool, a spacious sunken sofa group awaits, shaded and also covered with glass, providing the perfect enclave to relish special moments with friends and family. 
As the day unfolds, it transforms into an ideal spot for leisurely afternoon sundowners, offering a serene vista of the scenic rice fields. 
Villa Vida ensures a haven for creating lasting memories in a stylish and comfortable setting.

Tucked away in a quiet gated cul de sac complex, Villa Vida offers utmost privacy. A private garage, with a covered entrance accommodating 1 car, several motor bikes, and surfboards. 
An additional car can be parked in front of the villa.

Villa Vida comes fully staffed and equipped, allowing you to unwind
and indulge without a worry in the world.

descriptionSections.body: Guests will be able to access the entire villa and have full privacy.

- Airport transfer

- Private cook (breakfast, lunch, dinner)
- Massages at the villa
- Nanny services
- Pool Fence
- Laundry
- Restaurant bookings
- Activities such as watersports, surf classes, cooking classes, water parks…
- Daily tours to visit temples, landscapes, villages…
- And much more! 

Don’t hesitate to ask us if you want to do some activities or visits while enjoying your stay at our villa!

name: Villa Daun – Guest Favorite 3BR Architectural Gem in Berawa

reviews.author: Abdullateef
reviews.comment:
I’ve stayed in many Airbnbs before, and usually the level of service and cleaning can be quite different from a hotel. But staying at Villa Daun genuinely felt like staying at a 5-star hotel.
The villa was beautiful, extremely clean, and very well maintained. The location was perfect—close to everything we needed, while the villa itself was in a peaceful and quiet area with no noise or disturbance.
What impressed us even more was the hospitality. Our flight was late in the evening, and after check-out they kindly allowed us to leave our luggage in their storage room at no extra charge. The staff were always friendly, welcoming, and very helpful throughout our stay.
We really enjoyed our time here and the villa exceeded our expectations. If I come back to Bali, Villa Daun will definitely be my first choice. Highly recommended!

The host was always quick to respond to any questions and very helpful throughout our stay. Daily housekeeping kept everything fresh and tidy. We would definitely recommend this villa and would happily stay here again! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

我們是一群台灣人（7位
一起到峇里島旅遊，住宿非常乾淨用過濾蓮蓬頭也只有一點黃黃的（大約住4晚）沒有像別人講的很髒
但唯一缺點是進入住宿的那條巷子很黑 如果要外出一定要叫車或結伴同行

reviews.author: Devi
reviews.comment:
We really loved our stay at this villa, it was just perfect for us. The property feels very new and was exceptionally clean throughout our visit. We arrived in the evening and received a warm welcome from the staffs; all the lights and air conditioning had already been turned on, and we were greeted with a refreshing welcome drink and fresh fruit, which was a lovely touch.
We especially appreciated the cleanliness and the beautiful design of Villa Daun. The villa was cleaned daily, and the staff were always quick to respond whenever we had any requests, making our stay even more comfortable.
The location is also very convenient, with plenty of cafés and restaurants nearby. Overall, this is truly a top-notch villa, and we would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a relaxing and well-maintained place to stay.

reviews.author: Faza
reviews.comment:
LOVED the interiors and design of this place. The dining table are was particularly nice to work and sit around in. We were in Bali for a work trip and could not have felt cozier here. 
Quiet spot, near the fun places, and staff was super helpful and friendly. 
We will be back!

reviews.author: Delvin
reviews.comment: Beatiful place even better than the picture, friendly responsive staff

reviews.author: Blen
reviews.comment:
We had an amazing stay at this villa in Berawa. The space was beautifully designed, clean, spacious, and felt like a true home away from home. Every room was comfortable and well thought out, making it perfect for relaxing with family and friends.
The location was ideal — quiet and private, yet still close to cafés, restaurants, and the beach.
The host was incredibly responsive and helpful, making check-in and the entire stay seamless. Everything was exactly as described (if not better).
We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend this villa to anyone visiting Bali. 💛🌴

reviews.author: Marcel
reviews.comment: sangat rekomendasi untuk tempat ini, karena tempat nya bersih, akses nya juga gampang, tuan rumah juga ramah dan respon nya sangat cepat, dan seluruh pegawainya sangat ramah dan baik dan sangat membantu....

reviews.author: Lelyta
reviews.comment:
We had an amazing stay at Daun Villa. The building quality is excellent, with high-quality amenities and well-maintained facilities throughout. The rooms are spacious, comfortable and thoughtfully designed, with dedicated bathrooms each. The pool is perfectly sized for a morning swim, and we were pleasantly surprised by the complete and well-equipped kitchenware provided. 
We also really appreciated how friendly and attentive the housekeepers were. To top it off, the location is very strategic, just minutes away from beautiful beaches, hip restaurants, and yoga studios. We’ll definitely return on our next visit to Bali.
