descriptionSections.body:
Searching for the perfect stay in Berawa?

Meet Villa Daun; a sleek, contemporary four bedroom escape right in the center of it all.

What to expect:

- Prime location near Berawa Beach, cafés, restaurants, and shops
- Bright, modern interiors with plenty of style
- Full service from a warm, professional team

Arrive, settle in, and let Villa Daun handle the rest. Your exceptional Berawa getaway begins here.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
Villa Daun by Teduh is part of a curated collection of premium private villas in Berawa, Bali, designed for guests seeking privacy, design-led comfort, and a more elevated Bali stay.

The moment you arrive, a sleek elongated pool immediately draws your attention, its wide steps offering the perfect spot to unwind on the sun loungers. To your right, the main residence opens into an elegant, open plan living area. The kitchen, dining space, and plush lounge connect seamlessly, framed by floor to ceiling glass doors that blur the line between indoor calm and tropical outdoor living. Whether opened to the breeze or closed for a cool, quiet atmosphere, the space is ideal for relaxing, sharing meals, or enjoying movie nights with views of lush greenery and the shimmering pool. 

Each bedroom is thoughtfully designed with its own private en suite. The ground floor master suite overlooks the pool and features a sophisticated layout with a luxurious bathroom complete with a bathtub. Upstairs, the remaining bedrooms offer enhanced privacy and comfort, including a second master suite; also equipped with its own bathtub. With its refined design, serene atmosphere, and prime Berawa location.

Villa Daun provides a luxurious retreat perfect for families and friends seeking an exceptional Bali getaway.

shortDesc: Bayangkan melangkah masuk ke dalam sanctuary privat 4 kamar tidur di Pererenan. Kolam renang pribadi berkilau, interior tropis yang elegan, dan pelayanan staf berdedikasi memastikan setiap detik liburan Anda di Bali terasa begitu berharga dan memulihkan energi jiwa.
description: Bayangkan melangkah masuk ke dalam sanctuary privat 4 kamar tidur di Pererenan. Kolam renang pribadi berkilau, interior tropis yang elegan, dan pelayanan staf berdedikasi memastikan setiap detik liburan Anda di Bali terasa begitu berharga dan memulihkan energi jiwa.
fullDesc:
Bayangkan Anda melangkah masuk ke dalam santuari tropis yang menakjubkan di mana kemewahan modern melebur sempurna dengan kehangatan keramahan Bali. Cala Blanca – Mediterranean 4BR Tropical Villa in Pererenan dirancang khusus bagi mereka yang mendambakan liburan eksklusif tanpa kompromi.

Begitu Anda membuka pintu, suasana hening dan damai seketika menyambut Anda. Kolam renang pribadi yang jernih diapit taman tropis yang rimbun, sementara ruang keluarga terbuka mengalir alami menghadirkan semilir angin sepoi yang menyejukkan. Setiap kamar tidur dilengkapi kasur king-size berstandar hotel bintang lima, linen katun premium, dan kamar mandi en-suite bertekstur batu alam yang menenangkan panca indera.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"We loved our stay. Staff were extremely friendly and helpful, villa was very private and comfortable. Certainly stay here again"

Ketika Anda memilih menginap di sini, Anda mengamankan privasi mutlak di salah satu kawasan paling bergengsi di Bali—hanya beberapa menit santai dari deretan kafe artisan terbaik, restoran kelas dunia, dan pesisir pantai eksotis, sembari tetap menikmati kedamaian total di oase pribadi Anda.

descriptionSections.body:
Escape to our exquisite four-bedroom masterpiece meticulously designed by the renowned Biombo Architects. Ideally nestled in the vibrant Pererenan area, next to trendy cafes, restaurants, and less than 1 kilometer from the beach.

Cala Blanca showcases a contemporary tropical design aesthetic, dominated by the use of natural elements like stone, timber ceilings, and lush greenery. 

It offers an unmatched blend of luxury, design, and comfort, creating an exceptional living experience.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
Step into Cala Blanca, a contemporary villa exuding pure luxury in a tropical setting.

At its core, the villa boasts a spacious living area with soaring ceilings, seamlessly transitioning between fully opening to the outdoors or being completely enclosed. Decorated with modern and elegant furniture, this area is surrounded by lush tropical plants, creating a peaceful oasis. 

The indoor sunken lounge features a U-shaped couch with a coffee table, ideal for gatherings with loved ones, all enveloped by the immersive tropical backdrop. 

The kitchen is fully equipped with modern amenities and includes a bar with stools, as well as a dining table accommodating up to eight. Its floor-to-ceiling windows welcome ample natural light and offer views of the lush garden and swimming pool. Do not hesitate to contact us to organize a personalized culinary experience with a chef, directly at the villa!

Outdoors, the villa boasts a pristine lagoon pool, perfect to unwind after a day of exploring the surrounding area. It also features bar seats, to sip your favorite drink directly in the swimming pool. The area is surrounded by a furnished backyard with an outdoor dining area and a comfortable sofa bench. This creates the perfect setting for relaxation while guests enjoy the refreshing waters of the pool.

The villa boasts four en-suite bedrooms with king-size beds, exuding tropical charm. Each bedroom is equipped with large closets and safety boxes to store your valuables. The master bedroom even features a rooftop balcony with bean bags and coffee table, making it the perfect setting for a Bali sunset experience while sipping a drink or watching the Bali's wonderful blue sky.

With 24/7 security, a dedicated staff, and the assurance of a gated complex, this villa offers a secure and indulgent tropical escape.

Nestled in the heart of the coveted Pererenan region, this villa enjoys a privileged location, granting you swift access to the renowned local beaches of Perenan and Pantai Lima, merely a short 10-minute drive away.

Rest assured, your stay in this opulent villa is an all-encompassing experience, as it comes fully equipped and is graced by our dedicated staff, ensuring that your every need is effortlessly catered to. 

Your tropical escape awaits!

descriptionSections.title: Guest access
descriptionSections.body: Guests enjoy exclusive use of the entire villa, ensuring total privacy throughout their stay.

descriptionSections.title: Other things to note
descriptionSections.body:
Included in every stay:

- Free welcome drink
- Villa staff with daily cleaning
- Bath towels for each guests
- Hi Speed Wi-Fi internet connection
- Safety boxes
- Concierge Services

Available upon request through our exclusive Concierge services:
- Airport transfer
- Car rental (with/without driver)
- Bike rental
- Breakfast upon request
- Massages at the villa
- Pool Fence 
- Laundry
- Restaurant bookings
- Activities such as watersports, surf classes, cooking classes, water parks…
- Daily tours to visit temples, landscapes, villages…
- And much more! 

Don’t hesitate to ask us if you want to do some activities or visits while enjoying your stay at our villa!

name: The Bull House – Iconic 6BR Temple of Leisure in Seminyak

reviews.name: Surya
reviews.comment:
To spend what we did and get no Chef or Butler service was disappointing. 
The place is well made but the upkeep is shockingly poor which absolutely gutted the whole experience we were so looking forward to.
No water pressure in the showers.
Living Area air conditioning was not up to mark
Bed Linen and the Bedroom air-conditioning were good, which was a saving grace
reviews.hostResponse:
Hi Surya, it’s very disappointing to read this review, especially as our team always makes every effort to provide the best possible service to our guests. We’re sorry that your experience did not meet your expectations, but we also feel that some aspects of your stay have been presented in a way that does not reflect the services and support actually available at the villa.
The villa has dedicated staff who clean and attend to the property daily. Chef-prepared meals can be arranged at an additional cost, and butler service is available. We are also reachable via WhatsApp and Airbnb throughout the stay to assist with any questions or issues.
Regarding the water pressure, the system was checked and is functioning properly. If hot water is used continuously for an extended period, the system may require some time to refill before the it returns to normal.
We respect your feedback, but we believe it is important to clarify these points so future guests have an accurate understanding of the services and support available at the villa. Thank you.

reviews.hostResponse: Dear Hanyue, it’s fantastic to hear you had such a great time with us! We’re already looking forward to your next visit!

reviews.hostResponse: Joachim, thank you for your lovely review. We’re so happy you had a great stay and truly appreciate your feedback. Hope to host you again soon :)

reviews.name: Unnati
reviews.comment:
Good things first: 
1. Beautiful place. 
2. Have all amenities in kitchen 
3. Someone available on texts for whatever we need and a posted security person outside. 
Average things: 
1. There is no onsite chef for breakfast or anything. we were told to arrange a chef from outside. 
2. There is no TV in any common areas. Just a dedicated cinema
3. Overall, the property is very quiet and lot of dogs barking around.
4. Its in an alley.
5. We expected a bit more service as our other villa in Bali was also taken care by the tropical door and we got amazing service.
6. There was continous water leakage in the living room
reviews.hostResponse:
Hi Unnati, thank you for your feedback and for the compliments on the villa. The property has recently been renovated, and we’re happy to know you enjoyed the design, amenities, and overall experience. Providing smooth communication, attentive service, and a safe environment for guests is always important to us.
All amenities and services provided are aligned with the information shared in the listing. A simple breakfast can be assisted by our staff upon request, while a private chef for specialty meals can also be arranged at an additional cost. TV is available in bar area, and the cinema room was intentionally designed as the main entertainment feature of the villa.
Regarding the dogs, they are outside the property and unfortunately not under our direct control. As in many areas of Bali, occasional neighborhood sounds can happen.
The water leakage was caused by the continuous heavy rain recently experienced in Bali, but it's also been fixed too.
We appreciate your feedback and will continue working to provide the best possible experience for future guests.

reviews.name: Abbey
reviews.comment:
Overall, a disappointing experience, especially given the premium price point of this villa. The grounds and size of the property were beautiful, but unfortunately the customer service and maintenance let it down badly.
There were multiple maintenance issues throughout our stay, including a staircase that felt genuinely dangerous. Staff were rarely around unless we specifically chased someone up, communication was difficult due to limited English, and the villa manager only attended after we requested to see him following several issues.
We’ve stayed in many Bali villas before, so our expectations came from previous experiences where staff are proactive, attentive and helpful with recommendations and service throughout the stay. Sadly, this villa fell far short of that standard. For the price paid, we expected a much higher level of service and upkeep.
reviews.hostResponse:
Hi Abbey,
We understand your expectations regarding value and service. However, we do believe the property, amenities, and level of support provided were consistent with both the pricing and the listing description.
The villa is properly maintained, including the staircase, which is clearly shown in the photos and is often appreciated by guests for its stylish and unique design. We trust that guests review the listing details and photos carefully before confirming their booking.
Our team provides daily cleaning service and remains available throughout each stay via WhatsApp, phone, Airbnb messaging, or in person whenever assistance is needed. While we always try to be as flexible as possible, unfortunately not every request can always be accommodated.
We value all feedback and will continue working to provide the best experience possible for future guests.

fullDesc:
Bayangkan Anda melangkah masuk ke dalam santuari tropis yang menakjubkan di mana kemewahan modern melebur sempurna dengan kehangatan keramahan Bali. The Bull House – Iconic 6BR Temple of Leisure in Seminyak dirancang khusus bagi mereka yang mendambakan liburan eksklusif tanpa kompromi.

Begitu Anda membuka pintu, suasana hening dan damai seketika menyambut Anda. Kolam renang pribadi yang jernih diapit taman tropis yang rimbun, sementara ruang keluarga terbuka mengalir alami menghadirkan semilir angin sepoi yang menyejukkan. Setiap kamar tidur dilengkapi kasur king-size berstandar hotel bintang lima, linen katun premium, dan kamar mandi en-suite bertekstur batu alam yang menenangkan panca indera.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"very spacious place nice if your traveling with a large group, the host was very friendly, responsive and responsible, there are convenience shops nearby as well!"

Ketika Anda memilih menginap di sini, Anda mengamankan privasi mutlak di salah satu kawasan paling bergengsi di Bali—hanya beberapa menit santai dari deretan kafe artisan terbaik, restoran kelas dunia, dan pesisir pantai eksotis, sembari tetap menikmati kedamaian total di oase pribadi Anda.

descriptionSections.body:
Step into the Bull House, a magnificient 6 bedroom oasis built and designed without any compromise. 

Nestled on a 20 ares land at walking distance to the world famous Batu belig beach, it boasts a 15 meters swimming pool, 6 tastefully decorated  bedrooms, a media room, a rooftop and a huge garden. 

Recognized as one of the best villas in Bali, the Bull House combines ultra-luxury amenities, boho design and top-notch hospitality services, including a personal butler.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
The Bull House offers an unparalleled experience of luxury and relaxation. 
From the stunning interior design to the massive infinity pool and beautifully landscaped gardens, every detail has been carefully thought out to ensure the ultimate in comfort and indulgence. 

As you step inside this stunning mansion, you'll be welcomed by an expansive and verdant garden filled with lush tropical plants and greenery. Crafted by a team of landscape specialists, the giant garden is the perfect option to enjoy Bali's incredible weather. 

You then face the massive and crystal clear 15m long swimming pool, well-suited to enjoy the warm bali sun with your loved ones. The exterior space also include another plunge pool with seating arrangements and a elegantly designed terrace.

Adjacent to the swimming pool are large bay windows, letting tons of natural light come through during the day. 

When entering the inside space of the Bull House, you will discover a one-of a kind interior design style, combining tropical artifacts from around the world with luxurious contemporary amenities. 

On your left side, sits a massive sofa which can accommodate up to 20 people, the perfect option for large gatherings.

An additional seating area and a large billiard table have also been installed in the living room for your enjoyment.

To the right of the living room lies a fully stocked kitchen, ideal for preparing meals yourself or having them expertly crafted by someone else. Every kitchen appliance has been meticulously chosen to meet the needs of any culinary desire.

Additionally, on the ground floor, there's a dining area featuring a huge table that can accommodate up to 12 people. Let us organize a personalized culinary experience where a skilled chef will come to the villa and prepare a variety of international dishes for you to try.

The Bull House has 6 beautifully decorated bedrooms, each featuring a luxurious en-suite bathroom with bathtub and top-of-the-line king-sized beds. Furthermore, each bedroom boasts a walk-in closet, large safety box, and air conditioning. The design of each room incorporates a blend of boho-chic accents and contemporary furnishings, creating a truly distinctive atmosphere.

The floating staircase leads you to the first floor, where a stylish bar counter with elegant stools, ambient lighting, and a smart TV creates the perfect spot to enjoy drinks, casual conversations, or a cozy movie night.

Just beyond, the villa’s rooftop terrace offers a breathtaking open-air escape. With a pergola-shaded dining area, plush lounges, and sweeping treetop views, this tropical haven blends natural wood and lush greenery to elevate every moment into a memorable experience.

Each stay at the Bull House comes with a personal and dedicated butler, available to assist you at any time.  Our housekeeping staff will also be available every day.

This incredible oasis has been designed for ultimate relaxation and comfort with great attention to details to ensure an unforgettable vacation.

Was such a surprise walking in to a cake and rose petals to help us celebrate a birthday- thank you!
reviews.hostResponse: Thank you so much for your kind and detailed review, Laura! We're so happy to hear that you enjoyed your stay and found the villa as stunning as expected. reviews.name: Hekmat
reviews.comment:
The decor of the villa is very nice—exactly as shown in the pictures. However, it requires serious maintenance. The place was very unclean; we all felt itchy during the night. There was dust and small bugs in the beds, likely due to the granite bed frames with mattresses placed inside. Bugs were found in the corners of the granite from the inside.
Although the bedrooms were cleaned and we were promised misting, nothing improved.
Additionally, the cleaners arrived before our 12 PM checkout time. As everyone knows, the final minutes are essential to pack up and leave, but this wasn’t respected. They also assumed we had stolen or broken a cup, which they later found upstairs. We found that accusation very disrespectful.
I wouldn’t recommend staying at this villa unless it undergoes proper deep cleaning and is managed more professionally.
It’s a beautiful place, and it’s unfortunate to see it so poorly managed.
reviews.hostResponse:
Hi Hekmat,
We find your comments both surprising and unfair, especially considering our team responded promptly to every request throughout your stay. The villa is thoroughly cleaned on a daily basis, and we can confidently confirm that there are absolutely no bed bugs. Small insects may occasionally appear, which is completely normal given the villa's location in Bali, a tropical island.
As for the checkout, we were as flexible and accommodating as possible. Our staff arrived 10 minutes before 12 PM simply to assist, not to rush you. In fact, you checked out well past the scheduled time, which we were happy to allow.
Regarding the cup, there was no accusation whatsoever. It was a routine inventory check, and the cup was found upstairs without issue. To frame this as an accusation is both misleading and unfair.
It is disappointing to receive such an exaggerated review, especially after the effort and responsiveness shown by our team. While we appreciate all feedback that helps us grow, we also believe it’s important to be fair and accurate in reviews. Thank you.

"We and my colleagues had a great time very special place"

Ketika Anda memilih menginap di sini, Anda mengamankan privasi mutlak di salah satu kawasan paling bergengsi di Bali—hanya beberapa menit santai dari deretan kafe artisan terbaik, restoran kelas dunia, dan pesisir pantai eksotis, sembari tetap menikmati kedamaian total di oase pribadi Anda.

descriptionSections.body:
Welcome to our brand new villa Berawa Breeze, where modern luxury meets the tranquil allure of tropical living. 

Designed and built without any compromise, this villa stands as a premier choice for a stylish stay at walking distance to the beach.

What to expect:
- Modern tropical design 
- Great location next to the beach and all Canggu best cafes/restaurants
- Fully equipped and staffed
 
Book your stay now and create unforgettable memories in our exclusive villa.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
As you enter Berawa Breeze, a spacious living area welcomes you, complete with high ceilings and expansive bay windows that flood the room with natural light. A comfortable sofa, a smart TV with Netflix, and soundbar are available. Directly ahead, a sizable dining table awaits, ideal for enjoying Indonesian cuisine with your group.

Adjacent to the living room is a fully equipped kitchen, complete with a bar area. 

In front of the living room, an expansive garden unfolds, showcasing a stunning lagoon-shaped pool, ideal for tanning under Bali's sunshine. Beside the pool, you'll find a circular sunken sofa and a cozy, covered chill-out area. 

The outdoor area also features a private sauna, offering a tranquil wellness experience and the perfect way to unwind after a day of exploring or beach activities. In addition, a second outdoor living area with spacious seating provides an ideal setting to enjoy evening drinks at dusk or gather with friends in an open-air atmosphere.

Each bedroom in Berawa Breeze is meticulously crafted, blending top-tier amenities with ethnic decor. All bedrooms are equipped with personal safety boxes for secure storage of belongings, a smart TV and feature en-suite bathrooms. Adding to the luxury, two of the bedrooms boast their own bathtubs. Some of the bedrooms also have their own balcony with views of the surroundings. 

Berawa Breeze boasts a clever design that merges tropical elements with unique decorations made of artifacts from across the globe. This creates not only a visually appealing space but also one that's comfortable and practical for guests. 

This villa includes a private parking area and is conveniently situated within walking distance to the beach. The renowned Cafe Del Mar is also just a short stroll away.

Come feel the Berawa Breeze with our exclusive villa!

descriptionSections.title: Guest access
descriptionSections.body: The whole villa and complete privacy.

descriptionSections.title: Other things to note
descriptionSections.body:
Included in every stay:

- Free welcome drink
- Villa staff with daily cleaning, and pool & garden maintenance 2/3 times per week
- Bath & Pool towels for each guests
- Hi Speed Wi-Fi internet connection
- Safety boxes
- Concierge Services

Available upon request through our exclusive Concierge services:

- Airport transfer
- Car rental (with/without driver)
- Bike rental
- Private cook
- Massages at the villa
- Nanny Services
- Pool Fence
- Laundry
- Restaurant bookings
- Activities such as watersports, surf classes, cooking classes, water parks…
- Daily tours to visit temples, landscapes, villages…
- And much more!

Don’t hesitate to ask us if you want to do some activities or visits while enjoying your stay at our villa!

reviews.name: Hilda
reviews.comment:
We really loved our stay at Coco Bay! The villa is so beautiful, with such a cool open layout, lots of greenery and so much natural light. We spent most of our time around the kitchen and pool area just hanging out together, which was probably our favourite part of the villa. The rooms are gorgeous and spacious.  The location was also great — close to restaurants, clubs, supermarkets and Finns, with a buggy available for nearby trips and very easy access for Grab drivers.
The staff were honestly amazing and so helpful with anything we needed. They arranged massages and floating breakfasts for us, laundry services. The food was amazing! A special thank you to Lely who helped me organise my husband’s birthday lunch at the villa, including the décor, photographer and food, which was delicious. They really made everything easy for us and we felt very well looked after throughout our stay. We would definitely stay at Coco Bay again and highly recommend booking this villa!

fullDesc:
Bayangkan Anda melangkah masuk ke dalam santuari tropis yang menakjubkan di mana kemewahan modern melebur sempurna dengan kehangatan keramahan Bali. Coco Bay – Grand 8BR Beachside Luxury Estate in Berawa dirancang khusus bagi mereka yang mendambakan liburan eksklusif tanpa kompromi.

Begitu Anda membuka pintu, suasana hening dan damai seketika menyambut Anda. Kolam renang pribadi yang jernih diapit taman tropis yang rimbun, sementara ruang keluarga terbuka mengalir alami menghadirkan semilir angin sepoi yang menyejukkan. Setiap kamar tidur dilengkapi kasur king-size berstandar hotel bintang lima, linen katun premium, dan kamar mandi en-suite bertekstur batu alam yang menenangkan panca indera.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"Our group stayed for three nights and had a great experience. One of the housekeepers, Nano, was very attentive. It's suitable for large groups."

Ketika Anda memilih menginap di sini, Anda mengamankan privasi mutlak di salah satu kawasan paling bergengsi di Bali—hanya beberapa menit santai dari deretan kafe artisan terbaik, restoran kelas dunia, dan pesisir pantai eksotis, sembari tetap menikmati kedamaian total di oase pribadi Anda.

descriptionSections.body:
Discover Coco Bay, an eight-bedroom architectural masterpiece in the heart of Canggu.

This villa boasts a contemporary modern-tropical design, featuring an impressive pool and sophisticated interior decor, making it a premier choice in Bali.

It also includes an entertainment cinema room, a fitness center, and three separate bedrooms each with their own private pools.

It is fully serviced with a committed team on the premises, guaranteeing constant comfort and privacy. 

Breakfast included :)

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
A retreat like no other, this villa in Berawa invites you to experience the perfect blend of space and serenity. With eight bedrooms and four pools, Coco Bay Villa offers an unparalleled escape into a world of luxury and relaxation.

Upon entering Coco Bay, you'll find yourself amidst a vast, verdant garden, highlighted by a crystal clear lagoon-shaped pool. The garden, adorned with numerous tropical plants, offers an authentic tropical ambiance. The outdoor space also includes a comfortable gazebo, perfect for unwinding with your preferred beverage as evening falls. 

The villa features eight luxurious bedrooms, including three lofts that offer a distinctive and elevated living experience with their own private pool. The master bedroom also features its own balcony with seating areas and views of the surroundings.

All bedrooms are spacious, tastefully decorated, and equipped with all amenities as well as their own-bathroom and safety boxes to ensure a securestay. 

The common living areas are designed for socializing and relaxation. A stylish and spacious living room serves as a central gathering point, featuring comfortable seating area and lush tropical plants, bringing the best of the outdoors, indoor.

Next to the living area sits a well-equipped kitchen offering a convenient space for our in-house chef to provide your favorite meals, or make you discover the delicacies of the Indonesian cuisine.

For leisure activities, explore the fitness room and the cinema room. The fully equipped gym is the perfect option for staying in shape during your vacation, while the cinema room provides a fantastic setting to enjoy your favorite movies with the comfort of a theater.

Coco Bay boasts a prime location, situated only around 850m from the beach and surrounded by a variety of cafes and restaurants. Our team will be more than happy to drive you to various locations using our in-house buggy.

It comes fully staffed, with a villa manager, butlers and your own personal chef.

Book now for a stylish escape!

descriptionSections.title: Guest access
descriptionSections.body: Guests will be able to access the entire villa and have full privacy.

descriptionSections.title: Other things to note
descriptionSections.body:
Breakfast is included every morning.

A buggy is available at Coco Bay Bali. Our staff will be more happy to drive you to nearby points of interests. 

We can also organize a floating breakfast experience and so much more. 

Guests are welcome to invite visitors to the villa, as long as the total number of people does not exceed 25 (including registered guests). Overnight stays by unregistered visitors require prior approval, and an additional charge of IDR 5,000,000 per person per night may apply for unauthorized stays.

Corkage Fee:
Corkage fee will apply 30% when guest bring their own coconut to the villa, any catering or mixologist from the outside villa. If guest request meals outside of provided menu, there will be additional cost of USD 10 per person + groceries fee + 10% service fee from the price of the groceries.
F & B System:
Food and beverage based on the menu system provide by the villa and subject to 21% tax and service charge. Lunch and dinner are pre order one day before. 

To ensure a peaceful and enjoyable experience for all guests, kindly note that parties are not permitted on the premises. Please also note that DJ equipment and additional external speakers are not allowed at the villa.


Do not hesitate to contact us for more information.

shortDesc: Bayangkan melangkah masuk ke dalam sanctuary privat 5 kamar tidur di Canggu & Berawa. Kolam renang pribadi berkilau, interior tropis yang elegan, dan pelayanan staf berdedikasi memastikan setiap detik liburan Anda di Bali terasa begitu berharga dan memulihkan energi jiwa.
description: Bayangkan melangkah masuk ke dalam sanctuary privat 5 kamar tidur di Canggu & Berawa. Kolam renang pribadi berkilau, interior tropis yang elegan, dan pelayanan staf berdedikasi memastikan setiap detik liburan Anda di Bali terasa begitu berharga dan memulihkan energi jiwa.
fullDesc:
Bayangkan Anda melangkah masuk ke dalam santuari tropis yang menakjubkan di mana kemewahan modern melebur sempurna dengan kehangatan keramahan Bali. Villa Milana – Sunlit 5BR Mediterranean Haven in Canggu dirancang khusus bagi mereka yang mendambakan liburan eksklusif tanpa kompromi.

Begitu Anda membuka pintu, suasana hening dan damai seketika menyambut Anda. Kolam renang pribadi yang jernih diapit taman tropis yang rimbun, sementara ruang keluarga terbuka mengalir alami menghadirkan semilir angin sepoi yang menyejukkan. Setiap kamar tidur dilengkapi kasur king-size berstandar hotel bintang lima, linen katun premium, dan kamar mandi en-suite bertekstur batu alam yang menenangkan panca indera.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"Beautiful place, very friendly stuff"

Ketika Anda memilih menginap di sini, Anda mengamankan privasi mutlak di salah satu kawasan paling bergengsi di Bali—hanya beberapa menit santai dari deretan kafe artisan terbaik, restoran kelas dunia, dan pesisir pantai eksotis, sembari tetap menikmati kedamaian total di oase pribadi Anda.

descriptionSections.body:
Discover tranquility in this 5-bedroom Canggu villa, where tropical and Mediterranean influences harmonize. Designed by a team of international architects, the main highlights of villa Milana are its massive pool, its rooftop area and its 5 beautifully appointed bedrooms.

With a seamless indoor-outdoor flow, this villa offers an elegant escape for those seeking a stylish stay. Every corner of Villa Milana has been designed with style and functionality. It comes fully staffed and equipped.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
Nestled in the heart of Canggu, this enchanting 5-bedroom villa offers a perfect blend of tropical serenity and Mediterranean allure. The villa exudes an atmosphere of relaxation and sophistication.

As you step through the entrance, you are greeted by a grand foyer that sets the tone for the entire residence. The design seamlessly fuses traditional Balinese elements with the charm of Mediterranean architecture, featuring white-washed walls, terracotta tiles, and wrought iron accents.

The outdoor spaces are a true highlight of this villa. The expansive terrace features a poolside lounge area, ideal for soaking up the sun! The private pool offers a refreshing oasis to cool off in the midst of the island's warmth. 
The villa also features a large rooftop area with seating spaces, perfect to enjoy the incredible Bali sunsets.

The spacious living areas are bathed in natural light, creating a warm and inviting ambiance. The open-plan layout seamlessly connects the living room, dining area, and a gourmet kitchen equipped with state-of-the-art appliances. Large sliding glass doors blur the lines between indoor and outdoor living, providing breathtaking views of the tropical garden and private pool. Villa Milana features a transparent glass to the pool, the perfect spot to make your nicest shots. 

Each of the five bedrooms is a sanctuary of comfort and style. The master suite boasts a private terrace overlooking the surroundings, creating a perfect spot for morning coffee or evening relaxation. The en-suite bathrooms are adorned with exquisite tiles, marble countertops, and luxurious fixtures, embodying a spa-like retreat.

The outdoor spaces are a true highlight of this villa. The expansive terrace features a poolside lounge area, ideal for soaking up the sun! The private pool offers a refreshing oasis to cool off in the midst of the island's warmth.

The villa's attention to detail extends to every corner, with carefully curated furnishings and decor that enhance the overall sense of luxury and comfort.

A perfect haven for those seeking tranquility and elegance, this 5-bedroom villa in Canggu is a testament to the seamless integration of tropical living and Mediterranean charm.

descriptionSections.title: Guest access
descriptionSections.body: The villa is completely private and only accessible by you.

descriptionSections.title: Other things to note
descriptionSections.body:
Included in every stay:

-Free welcome drink
-Villa’s staff with daily cleaning, and pool & garden maintenance 2/3 times per week
-Bath & Pool towels for each guests
-Hi Speed Wifi internet connection
-Safety boxes 
-Concierge Services

Available upon request through our exclusive Concierge services:

-Airport transfer
-Car rental (with/without driver)
-Bike rental
-Private cook
-Massages at the villa
-Nanny services
-Pool fence
-Laundry
-Restaurant bookings
-Activities such as water sports, surf classes, cooking classes, water parks…
-Daily tours to visit temples, landscapes, villages…
-And much more! 

Don’t hesitate to ask us if you want to do some activities or visits while enjoying your stay at our villa !

fullDesc:
Bayangkan Anda melangkah masuk ke dalam santuari tropis yang menakjubkan di mana kemewahan modern melebur sempurna dengan kehangatan keramahan Bali. Beachside Haven – Elegant 4BR Modern Villa Steps from Canggu Beach dirancang khusus bagi mereka yang mendambakan liburan eksklusif tanpa kompromi.

Begitu Anda membuka pintu, suasana hening dan damai seketika menyambut Anda. Kolam renang pribadi yang jernih diapit taman tropis yang rimbun, sementara ruang keluarga terbuka mengalir alami menghadirkan semilir angin sepoi yang menyejukkan. Setiap kamar tidur dilengkapi kasur king-size berstandar hotel bintang lima, linen katun premium, dan kamar mandi en-suite bertekstur batu alam yang menenangkan panca indera.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"Great hospitality and a perfect location. 
The hosts were very welcoming and helpful. Would definitely stay here again."

Ketika Anda memilih menginap di sini, Anda mengamankan privasi mutlak di salah satu kawasan paling bergengsi di Bali—hanya beberapa menit santai dari deretan kafe artisan terbaik, restoran kelas dunia, dan pesisir pantai eksotis, sembari tetap menikmati kedamaian total di oase pribadi Anda.

descriptionSections.body:
Looking for the perfect place to stay in Canggu?

Villa Vida Mira is an elegant and luxurious 4-bedroom villa, perfectly located in the central canggu. 
With its sleek design, spacious spaces, it is the perfect option for a stylish stay on the Island of Gods. 

What to expect:

- Central location in Canggu
- 3 mins walk to the beach
- Top-notch amenities
- Modern and luxury design 

The villa comes fully furnished and staffed, so you don't have to worry about a thing!

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
Nestled only a stones throw away from to the all the hottest place in Canggu. Villa Vida Mira boasts the perfect blend of tropical charm and contemporary luxury. It’s beautiful interiors and outdoor living spaces will make you feel like you’re in paradise. 

Step inside this fully-equipped villa, where every detail has been carefully curated for your comfort. From spacious living areas to modern amenities, including a fully-equipped kitchen, Wi-Fi, and entertainment systems, we ensure a seamless stay.

Escape to tranquility in our four beautifully appointed bedrooms, each a sanctuary of relaxation. 
Every room is equipped with air conditioning to ensure your perfect temperature and features its own en-suite bathroom for added privacy. 
The master bedroom, located on the upper level, invites you to unwind in its king-size bed. 
On the ground floor, discover three additional bedrooms: two offering the comfort of double beds (created by seamlessly joining two singles) and a third with two individual single beds, providing flexible sleeping arrangements for all guests.

Whether you’re traveling with family or friends, everyone is sure to find a space to relax and unwind. Soak up the sun on a lounger or take a refreshing dip in the swimming pool, this villa has everything you need for an unforgettable holiday. 

For those who seek excitement, our villas prime location means you’re just a short walk from the vibrant beach club venues and local bars. Food lovers will also be delighted by the array of fabulous local restaurants nearby. 

Our dedicated staff are on hand to cater to your every need, providing personalized service to enhance your experience, we are here to make your stay unforgettable.

Escape to Villa Vida Mira and indulge in the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and natural beauty.

descriptionSections.title: Guest access
descriptionSections.body: Full privacy and reserved for guests.

descriptionSections.title: Other things to note
descriptionSections.body:
Included in every stay:

-Free welcome drink
-Villa’s staff with daily cleaning, and pool & garden maintenance 2/3 times per week
-Bath & Pool towels for each guests
-Hi Speed Wi-Fi internet connection
-Safety boxes 
-Concierge Services

Available upon request through our exclusive Concierge services:

-Airport transfer
-Car rental (with/without driver)
-Bike rental
-Breakfast upon request
-Private cook
-Massages at the villa
-Nanny services
-Pool fence
-Laundry
-Restaurant bookings
-Activities such as water sports, surf classes, cooking classes, water parks…
-Daily tours to visit temples, landscapes, villages…
-And much more! 

Don’t hesitate to ask us if you want to do some activities or visits while enjoying your stay at our villa!

fullDesc:
Bayangkan Anda melangkah masuk ke dalam santuari tropis yang menakjubkan di mana kemewahan modern melebur sempurna dengan kehangatan keramahan Bali. Wellness Estate Canggu – High-End 4BR Villa with Sauna, Ice Bath & Gym dirancang khusus bagi mereka yang mendambakan liburan eksklusif tanpa kompromi.

Begitu Anda membuka pintu, suasana hening dan damai seketika menyambut Anda. Kolam renang pribadi yang jernih diapit taman tropis yang rimbun, sementara ruang keluarga terbuka mengalir alami menghadirkan semilir angin sepoi yang menyejukkan. Setiap kamar tidur dilengkapi kasur king-size berstandar hotel bintang lima, linen katun premium, dan kamar mandi en-suite bertekstur batu alam yang menenangkan panca indera.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"Perfect Stay, Clean villa with very good daily housekeeping service. Walk to Beach Clubs and yet enjoy privacy"

Ketika Anda memilih menginap di sini, Anda mengamankan privasi mutlak di salah satu kawasan paling bergengsi di Bali—hanya beberapa menit santai dari deretan kafe artisan terbaik, restoran kelas dunia, dan pesisir pantai eksotis, sembari tetap menikmati kedamaian total di oase pribadi Anda.

descriptionSections.body:
Welcome to Villa Aless, a French-designed 4BR luxury villa in Berawa - Canggu. Just 5 minutes from the beach and Bali’s most iconic cafés, boutiques, and beach clubs.

Unwind in your massive private pool, soak in the jacuzzi, detox in the sauna, and recharge with an ice bath before a rejuvenating workout in your private gym.

Fully staffed and completely private, every detail has been taken care of so you can simply relax, indulge, and enjoy.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
Upon entering Villa Aless, you’re welcomed by an airy tropical design and a crystal-clear pool.  It's an ideal place to unwind after a day exploring Bali. Sunbathe on the deckchairs or relax in the outdoor lounge, complete with cozy footstools and seating areas.

Inside, floor-to-ceiling bay windows fill the villa with natural light. The living room offers plush seating, a smart TV, and Netflix for your entertainment.

The dining area seats up to 10 guests, and our team can arrange a private chef to create a personalized culinary experience. Adjacent, the fully equipped kitchen lets you cook (or be cooked for!) with ease.

Stay active in your private gym, and rest in one of four spacious en-suite bedrooms, each featuring a king-size bed. Two bedrooms can accommodate an extra bed, allowing up to 10 guests in total.

Head to the rooftop terrace for unforgettable Bali sunsets from the private jacuzzi and ice bath, surrounded by panoramic views. There’s also a sauna for deep relaxation.

Located just 5 minutes from Berawa Beach, within a secure gated complex with a private garage, Villa Aless combines comfort, privacy, and modern luxury.

Fully staffed and fully equipped, and everything has been taken care of, so you can simply relax, indulge, and enjoy.

Note:
Additional guests (9th & 10th person) will be charged USD 36/person/night for extra bed setup.
Maximum capacity: 10 guests.

descriptionSections.title: Guest access
descriptionSections.body: The whole villa will be yours and you will get complete privacy.

descriptionSections.title: Other things to note
descriptionSections.body:
Included in every stay:
-Free welcome drink
-Villa staff with daily cleaning
-Bath towels for each guests
-Hi Speed Wi-Fi internet connection
-Safety boxes
-Concierge Services
- Cot and High Chair available 

Available upon request through our exclusive Concierge services:
-Airport transfer
-Car rental (with/without driver)
-Bike rental
- Daily breakfast available at the villa with extra cost and free for children under 6 years
-Massages at the villa
-Nanny services
-Pool Fence
-Laundry
-Restaurant bookings
-Activities such as watersports, surf classes, cooking classes, water parks…
-Daily tours to visit temples, landscapes, villages…
-And much more!

Don’t hesitate to ask us if you want to do some activities or visits while enjoying your stay at our villa!

reviews.name: Hussin
reviews.comment: The property itself is excellent—spacious rooms, very clean, a fully equipped kitchen, and a perfect location close to everything. However, I experienced two major issues. First, the electricity frequently cuts off due to the villa’s meter, not the utility company, and often at inconvenient times such as midday. Second, the management was disappointing. The staff responsible did not take problems seriously, gave inaccurate explanations, and even asked me to check and fix the meter myself instead of handling it properly. On one occasion, I lost power for a long time and was told it was a company blackout, but later it turned out to be the villa’s meter. This lack of responsibility made the stay frustrating despite the property’s great potential.
reviews.hostResponse:
Hi Hussin, thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We’re glad to hear that you appreciated the villa’s spacious layout, cleanliness, and location, and we’re truly sorry that the issues you encountered impacted your overall experience.
Regarding the electricity, this is not something we’ve experienced with previous guests, but we take your comments very seriously. The meter and electrical system have since been thoroughly checked to ensure this does not recur.
In terms of the communication with our team, they were ready to inspect the meter immediately. Since you requested to keep the villa private until the 2 PM cleaning time, they asked whether you were comfortable with them entering or if you preferred to take a quick look from your side. We understand how this may have been perceived, and we sincerely apologize if it came across as shifting responsibility, that was certainly not the intention.
We truly appreciate your feedback, as it helps us improve, and we hope we’ll have the chance to welcome you again for a smoother and more enjoyable stay.

reviews.name: Farah
reviews.comment: The villa in Umalas was a decent stay, but there were a few issues. The electricity went down twice during our stay, and we had to switch it back on from the main power system. The bedding didn’t smell fresh, though we were told it had been cleaned. Overall, it was an okay stay, but there’s room for improvement.
reviews.hostResponse:
Dear Farah,
Thank you for your feedback. We appreciate you taking the time to share your experience.
First and foremost, we’d like to clarify that the villa was in impeccable condition for your stay. The property had been freshly painted, fully revarnished, and updated, including the installation of new shower heads. Everything was functioning perfectly, and the villa was thoroughly cleaned to ensure a high standard of comfort and hygiene.
Regarding the power outages, we want to provide some important context. The villa has never had electrical issues under normal use. One of the outages you experienced was a general blackout affecting the entire Umalas district, completely beyond our control. The second instance occurred due to an overload caused by the simultaneous use of multiple high-power appliances—all air conditioners at maximum power, the oven, the microwave, and multiple hairdryers running at the same time. Like any property, there are safety thresholds, and in such cases, the system temporarily shuts down as a precaution. This is not a fault of the villa but rather a standard protective measure to prevent electrical hazards.
We always strive to provide a seamless experience, and we regret any inconvenience you faced. However, we also encourage guests to be mindful of energy consumption to prevent avoidable power interruptions.
Lastly, we take cleanliness very seriously, and all bedding is professionally laundered before each stay. We will follow up with our housekeeping team to ensure our high standards are consistently upheld.
We appreciate your feedback and hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again for an even better experience in the future. :)

fullDesc:
Bayangkan Anda melangkah masuk ke dalam santuari tropis yang menakjubkan di mana kemewahan modern melebur sempurna dengan kehangatan keramahan Bali. Villa Aless – Serene 3BR Tropical Pool Hideaway in Umalas dirancang khusus bagi mereka yang mendambakan liburan eksklusif tanpa kompromi.

Begitu Anda membuka pintu, suasana hening dan damai seketika menyambut Anda. Kolam renang pribadi yang jernih diapit taman tropis yang rimbun, sementara ruang keluarga terbuka mengalir alami menghadirkan semilir angin sepoi yang menyejukkan. Setiap kamar tidur dilengkapi kasur king-size berstandar hotel bintang lima, linen katun premium, dan kamar mandi en-suite bertekstur batu alam yang menenangkan panca indera.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"Absolutely loved our stay. We were very sad to leave. We will definitely be back! Loved the big comfy beds with white sheets and great AC. 10/10"

Ketika Anda memilih menginap di sini, Anda mengamankan privasi mutlak di salah satu kawasan paling bergengsi di Bali—hanya beberapa menit santai dari deretan kafe artisan terbaik, restoran kelas dunia, dan pesisir pantai eksotis, sembari tetap menikmati kedamaian total di oase pribadi Anda.

descriptionSections.body:
Welcome to Villa Kanopi, your stunning 3-bedroom retreat in the heart of Umalas. This brand new modern villa is beautifully designed with tasteful decor and luxurious amenities, perfect for a relaxing vacation with family or friends. 
Enjoy direct access to the trendy neighborhood of Berawa, which is just a stone's throw away from the villa. 
Located just a short 7-minute drive from the beach, Villa Kanopi is the ideal place to soak up the sun and enjoy the laid-back vibe of Canggu.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
Indulge in the ultimate comfort and luxury in each of our three exquisite bedrooms, where every detail has been carefully considered to ensure a truly relaxing and peaceful stay. Each bedroom features an en-suite bathroom, a smart TV, a high-quality mattress, air conditioning, and a ceiling fan for your comfort. Automatic curtains add extra convenience and privacy, creating the perfect space to unwind after a day of exploring.

Relax and unwind in your own private pool with outdoor shower, surrounded by lush tropical gardens. The villa's canopy is the perfect spot to enjoy your morning coffee or a good book in the shade. The spacious enclosed living room is tastefully decorated with an eclectic mix of contemporary designs and natural materials. The large glass windows and doors can be opened to let in the refreshing breeze from the nearby banana field.

The living room is equipped with air conditioning, and you'll find the most comfortable sofas to relax and enjoy your stay. Whether you're having great discussions with your family or friends, or watching the huge TV screen with Netflix or YouTube, you'll feel right at home. The open kitchen is fully equipped with a gas stove, oven, microwave, dishwasher, blender, and Nespresso machine, perfect if you want to cook or hire a private chef.

The villa is nestled in a quiet gang, yet it's just a short stroll to famous restaurants, shops, and cafes. Don't miss the wonderful French bakery 7am, the famous Bali Direct Store, or the marvelous pizzas of La Fabricca. You can also enjoy high-quality restaurants such as Bonito or Olala, and many other local hotspots.

Stay connected with high-speed WiFi (Global Extreme), and rest assured that the villa is fully equipped and staffed with daily cleaning. Come and experience the perfect blend of comfort, luxury, and tranquility at Villa Kanopi. Book your stay now!!

descriptionSections.title: Guest access
descriptionSections.body: Full access and complete privacy.

descriptionSections.title: Other things to note
descriptionSections.body:
At Villa Kanopi, we want to ensure that your stay is nothing short of exceptional. That's why we offer a range of amenities and services to cater to your every need. Included in every stay, you'll receive:
-	A complimentary welcome drink upon arrival
-	Daily cleaning services, and pool and garden maintenance twice a week to keep your villa in pristine condition
-	Bath & Pool towels for each guest
-	Access to high-speed WiFi internet connection and safety boxes in each bedroom for added peace of mind

As part of our exclusive Concierge services, we offer a range of additional services upon request, such as:
-	Airport transfers
-	Car rental (with or without driver)
-	Bike rental
-	Breakfast
-	Private cook
-	Massages at the villa
-      Nanny services
-	Pool fence
-	Laundry
-	Restaurant bookings
-	And much more
We can also help you plan activities during your stay, such as water sports, surf classes, cooking classes, water parks, daily tours to visit temples, landscapes, villages, and more. Don't hesitate to ask us if you want to do something special while enjoying your stay at Villa Kanopi. Our concierge team is here to make your vacation unforgettable.

this villa looks great in photos, but the reality is far from what’s advertised.
reviews.hostResponse:

Our listing photos reflect the villa’s current condition, and we take upkeep seriously to ensure all guests receive the standard shown online.

shortDesc: Bayangkan melangkah masuk ke dalam sanctuary privat 1 kamar tidur di Pererenan. Kolam renang pribadi berkilau, interior tropis yang elegan, dan pelayanan staf berdedikasi memastikan setiap detik liburan Anda di Bali terasa begitu berharga dan memulihkan energi jiwa.
description: Bayangkan melangkah masuk ke dalam sanctuary privat 1 kamar tidur di Pererenan. Kolam renang pribadi berkilau, interior tropis yang elegan, dan pelayanan staf berdedikasi memastikan setiap detik liburan Anda di Bali terasa begitu berharga dan memulihkan energi jiwa.
fullDesc:
Bayangkan Anda melangkah masuk ke dalam santuari tropis yang menakjubkan di mana kemewahan modern melebur sempurna dengan kehangatan keramahan Bali. Alua Loft – Bohemian 1BR Designer Sanctuary in Pererenan dirancang khusus bagi mereka yang mendambakan liburan eksklusif tanpa kompromi.

Begitu Anda membuka pintu, suasana hening dan damai seketika menyambut Anda. Kolam renang pribadi yang jernih diapit taman tropis yang rimbun, sementara ruang keluarga terbuka mengalir alami menghadirkan semilir angin sepoi yang menyejukkan. Setiap kamar tidur dilengkapi kasur king-size berstandar hotel bintang lima, linen katun premium, dan kamar mandi en-suite bertekstur batu alam yang menenangkan panca indera.

Ulasan tamu terbaik kami:
"Was staying there a week. Host was very friendly and helpful! Neighbourhood is quiet. Great location"

Ketika Anda memilih menginap di sini, Anda mengamankan privasi mutlak di salah satu kawasan paling bergengsi di Bali—hanya beberapa menit santai dari deretan kafe artisan terbaik, restoran kelas dunia, dan pesisir pantai eksotis, sembari tetap menikmati kedamaian total di oase pribadi Anda.

descriptionSections.body:
Discover villa Tala, a 1 bedroom designer villa located in Pererenan next to Canggu.

Combining luxury, design and functionality, its unique design has been internationally recognized and crafted to create an ambiance of peace, comfort and serenity. With its one spacious bedroom, this villa is ideal for couples seeking a romantic getaway or solo travelers looking for a peaceful retreat.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
Fully equipped designer loft/villa in Pererenan

Step into this beautiful Villa Tala.

There is 1 spacious bedroom, delivered with a built-in wardrobe and smart TV upstairs. The bedroom is fitted with high-end furnishings, a comfortable king-size bed and boasts a large window that let in ample natural light and offer views of the surroundings.

The ground floor features the bathroom, an open plan concept with a high ceiling up to 5 meters overlooking the swimming pool.

The open-plan living area also features a fully equipped kitchen, a bar table and comfortable seating making it the perfect space to relax and unwind after a day of exploring the area.
 
The property features a private swimming pool using minimalistic and mediterranean inspirations

Villa Tala is located in the heart of Pererenan, Bali, the property is just a short drive away from the famous Pererenan Beach, one of Bali's most popular surf spots, and offers easy access to a wide range of local shops, restaurants, and bars. It is also located close to famous on the rise restaurants such as Touché, Woods or Shelter, just to name few!

Experience the ultimate in luxury and comfort at Villa Tala and create unforgettable memories in one of the world's most beautiful destinations.

The property is secured and offer complete privacy to its guests.

descriptionSections.title: Guest access
descriptionSections.body: Full access and complete privacy.

descriptionSections.title: Other things to note
descriptionSections.body:
Included in every stay:
-Free welcome drink
-Villa staff with daily cleaning
-Bath towels for each guests
-Hi Speed Wi-Fi internet connection
-Safety boxes
-Concierge Services

Available upon request through our exclusive Concierge services:
-Airport transfer
-Car rental (with/without driver)
-Bike rental
-Breakfast upon request
-Massages at the loft
-Nanny services
-Pool Fence
-Laundry
-Restaurant bookings
-Activities such as watersports, surf classes, cooking classes, water parks…
-Daily tours to visit temples, landscapes, villages…
-And much more!

Don’t hesitate to ask us if you want to do some activities or visits while enjoying your stay at our villa!

descriptionSections.body:
Looking for the perfect place to stay in Pererenan? 

Villa Satiya is a highly exclusive four-bedroom river front property with a stunning rice field view in Pererenan, Bali.
This villa mixes traditional Asian and contemporary design.
Situated less than 45 minutes from the airport, as well as 5 minutes drive from Pererenan Beach and Canggu with all its restaurants, bars, nightlife and boutiques.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
Villa Satiya is a true oasis of luxury and relaxation, set amidst 900 square meters of beautifully landscaped gardens. 

The villa itself is a grand 450 square meter two-story building, featuring a spacious and elegantly furnished living room that flows seamlessly into a 160 square meter open dining and living area featuring a pool table.
From here, you can admire the breathtaking views of the 90 square meter L-shaped swimming pool, the tranquil river, and the verdant rice fields.

The villa is fully equipped and staffed to ensure that your stay is as effortless and enjoyable as possible. 

The fully equipped kitchen is perfect for preparing your own meals or having a personal chef cook for you, and the villa is also fully staffed with daily cleaning and pool and garden maintenance occurring two to three times a week.

With four luxurious bedrooms, each featuring en-suite bathrooms, Villa Satiya is the perfect retreat for families or groups seeking a memorable and indulgent holiday on the island of the gods. 

The villa offers an unrivaled level of privacy and tranquility, making it the ultimate destination for those seeking a peaceful and rejuvenating escape.

So if you're looking to unwind and indulge in the finer things in life, look no further than Villa Satiya.

descriptionSections.title: Guest access
descriptionSections.body: Guests will be able to access the entire villa and have full privacy.

descriptionSections.title: Other things to note
descriptionSections.body:
Included in every stay:

-Free welcome drink
-Villa’s staff with daily cleaning, and pool & garden maintenance 2/3 times per week
-Bath & Pool towels for each guests
-Hi Speed Wifi internet connection
-Safety boxes 
-Concierge Services

Available upon request through our exclusive Concierge services:

-Airport transfer
-Car rental (with/without driver)
-Bike rental
-Breakfast upon request
-Private cook
-Massages at the villa
-Nanny services
-Pool fence
-Laundry
-Restaurant bookings
-Activities such as watersports, surf classes, cooking classes, water parks…
-Daily tours to visit temples, landscapes, villages…
-And much more!

 Don’t hesitate to ask us if you want to do some activities or visits while enjoying your stay at our villa!

descriptionSections.body:
Nestled in the tranquil neighbourhood of Umalas surrounded by rice fields and tropical greenery, Villa Taijasa tastefully combines traditional Balinese elements with a Western twist. 

It's in a perfect central location between Seminyak and Canggu, within walking distance to boutique cafes and trendy restaurants.

Our staff can assist with grocery shopping and simple breakfast cooking for free. You just need to pay for the cost of groceries itself.

descriptionSections.title: The space
descriptionSections.body:
A vaulted living space with stone floors and shelves of pottery and plants exudes a warmth to match Bali's weather and hospitality at this peaceful villa. Fold glass doors open to the coastal air, lounge by the pool, and take one of a double set of stairs up to a private suite and balcony. Set in the peaceful Umalas district, the villa is just a 5-minute drive from all the hip and happening spots in Seminyak and Canggu. 

It's in the same area as majority of trendy restaurants like Metis, Sardine or Sarong and dozens of boutiques, yet you are away from all the noise, traffic, pollution and commotion of downtown Seminyak. Rice fields are still all around the area and across the street, it's a quiet area without night club anywhere in the neighborhood.

This marvelous villa features 5 en-suite bedrooms and a guest bathroom. It is fully furnished and equipped with finest quality furnishings and decor which provide a great deal of luxury, comfort and style. This two-storeys property generously offers a beautiful lush green garden, AC, spacious living area, dining area, fully equipped kitchen, swimming pool, storage, water dispenser, internet throughout the house and a big parking area.. 

Villa Taijasa comes fully staffed, so all you have to do is kick back, relax and enjoy your stay in Bali. 
Kadek, Gusti, Krisna, and Made, have been with us for a long time; they are trustworthy,  speak great English, and are very service oriented, always ready to please and have a constant smile on their faces.  The staff includes housekeepers, gardener, pool and most importantly, your own private concierge.
Mr.G is a rare pearl, he will make sure to help you with as many of your requests as possible (to organize a driver for the day, motorbike rentals, boat or plane reservations, helping you with tours of the island, organize some massage for you in the villa, making recommendations of places to visit…).  All this is included when you stay at Villa Taijasa; we want to make sure that your stay with us is absolutely wonderful and memorable.

Villa Taijasa comes with all the modern amenities, including your own private pool, colorful garden, large open living and dining area, full kitchen, wireless Internet, flat screen TV with cable (dozens and dozens of channels), speaker. 

Many of our guests have found what they are looking for in Bali in Villa Taijasa, and I hope you can too.
